title: Technical Support Engineer (Fresher)
description:
**Job Description:** Technical Support Engineer (Fresher)

**Company:** Trasol Technologies  
**Job Title:** Technical Support Engineer  
**Experience:** Fresher (0–1 year)  
**Employment Type:** Full-time  
**Work Location:** Tiruppur

**About Trasol Technologies**

Trasol Technologies is an IT services and digital transformation company providing solutions across Microsoft 365, Microsoft Azure, Dynamics 365, Power Platform, Salesforce, cloud services, and IT infrastructure. We help businesses improve productivity, security, and operational efficiency through technology.

**Job Summary**

We are looking for an enthusiastic and technically inclined **Technical Support Engineer** to join our team. This opportunity is ideal for fresh graduates who are interested in troubleshooting technical issues, supporting end users, and developing their skills in IT support, networking, cloud technologies, and Microsoft solutions.

The selected candidate will receive guidance and training to diagnose technical problems, resolve user queries, and ensure smooth day-to-day IT operations.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Provide first-level technical support for hardware, software, operating system, and connectivity issues.
* Troubleshoot Windows operating system, desktop, laptop, printer, and basic network-related problems.
* Assist users with Microsoft 365 applications, including Outlook, Microsoft Teams, Word, Excel, and related services.
* Support basic installation, configuration, and maintenance of computer systems and applications.
* Diagnose internet connectivity, Wi-Fi, LAN, and other basic networking issues.
* Assist with user account creation, password resets, access permissions, and basic IT administration.
* Record, track, and update support tickets, ensuring timely resolution of reported issues.
* Escalate complex technical issues to the appropriate team and follow up until resolution.
* Maintain technical documentation, troubleshooting steps, and support records.
* Follow IT security guidelines and help users adopt safe computing practices.

**Required Skills**

* Basic knowledge of computer hardware, software, and Windows operating systems.
* Understanding of fundamental networking concepts, such as IP addresses, DNS, DHCP, LAN, and Wi-Fi.
* Familiarity with Microsoft Office applications and Microsoft 365 is an advantage.
* Basic understanding of troubleshooting methods and problem-solving.
* Good verbal and written communication skills.
* Willingness to learn new technologies and work collaboratively with the team.
* Strong customer-service orientation, patience, and attention to detail.

**Educational Qualification**

* B.E. / B.Tech in Computer Science, Information Technology, Electronics, or a related discipline.
* B.Sc. Computer Science, BCA, or equivalent IT-related qualifications may also be considered.
* Freshers and candidates with up to one year of relevant experience are welcome.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Basic knowledge of Microsoft Azure, Microsoft 365 administration, or IT support tools.
* Familiarity with remote desktop tools and ticketing systems.
* Microsoft fundamentals certifications, such as AZ-900 or MS-900, are an added advantage but not mandatory.

**What We Offer**

* Training and mentorship from experienced technical professionals.
* Hands-on exposure to real-world IT support and troubleshooting.
* Opportunities to learn Microsoft cloud technologies and enterprise IT solutions.
* A collaborative work environment with opportunities for professional growth.
* Support for developing relevant technical skills and certifications.

Pay: ₹15,000.00 - ₹20,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Cell phone reimbursement
* Paid sick time
* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person

title: Senior Engineer-VOS
description:
**Senior Engineer - VOS**

**Job Summary**

If you are a design professional, Emerson has a great opportunity for you! We are seeking a VOS Engineering Team member to support our Persistent Sensing Team. This position will work to develop the General Arrangement Drawings and Bill of Materials for Emerson's Actuation Technologies business. You will take part in project-wide reviews of requirements, specifications, and detailed design Drawings. You will also be responsible for collaborating with internal customers such as the sales team and project managers to understand project schedule and scope requirements in high-quality design in accordance with our Quality system, as well as ensuring Engineering deliverables are prepared with due diligence and appropriate consideration of customer requirements.

The successful candidate will be skilled at planning and delivering the deliverables and will have overall accountability for the timely delivery of technical Overall Drawings including bill of materials.

You will be working for a company that believes a diverse, equitable and inclusive work environment contributes to the rich exchange of ideas that encourages innovation.

**In This Role, Your Responsibilities Will Be:**

* Detailed analysis of the technical specifications of the customer orders. Interaction with Inside Sales, PMO and Application Engineering departments to clarify the definition of the scope of supply.
* Participate in the handover meeting and discuss with sales and project management team on the project requirements and any deviations.
* Creating wiring, schematic and general arrangement drawings in accordance with the project specifications. Create Material Master and Bill of Materials in SAP.
* Work on Design Change requests (ECO/ECN).
* Ensuring high Quality of Deliverables and fulfil on-time delivery commitments.
* Submitting accurate metrics and Time Tracking report.
* Organize documents using Windchill or Team Center or Enovia.
* Investigate and resolve operational problems from an engineering perspective.
* Foster and maintain positive relationships with local and global team members.
* Willing to learn and explore new technology.
* Should possess analytical approach in solving problems.

You promote high visibility of shared contributions to goals. You quickly and significantly act in constantly evolving, unexpected situations. You actively seek input from pertinent sources to make timely and well-informed decisions. You handle the risk that comes with moving forward when the outcome is not certain.

**For This Role, You Will Need:**

* Minimum 6-8 years of experience in CAD, PLM, ERP tool.
* Good knowledge of Pneumatic and Hydraulic Fluid flow systems.
* Proficient in 3D modeling, Assembly, Tubing and 2D drafting standards in CREO.
* Hands-on experience on Engineering Calculations to verify the design.
* Good Engineering knowledge required to apply concepts in Valve operating system Engineering.
* Good application Knowledge of GD&T and Tolerance stack-up.
* Good understanding of engineering materials, castings, weld design, fabrication, Sheetmetal and standard manufacturing processes.
* Good working knowledge of ASTM, ASME, ANSI, API, ISO & other standards related to Oil and Gas industry.
* Decisive, drive and ability to deliver effective and innovative solutions.
* Fluent with Microsoft Office Tools.
* Self-motivated, capable of working with minimal supervision.
* Excellent analytical skills and results oriented.
* Excellent Written and Verbal Communication skills.
* Ability to drive change and effectively handle multiple priorities.

**Preferred Qualifications that Set You Apart:**

* Bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering or equivalent.
* Relevant experience in mechanical design, industrial equipment. (Actuators, valves, gearboxes, boilers, other pressure equipment or special purpose machine)
* Proficiency in CREO, Windchill or any other equivalent CAD/PLM Tools.

Through our benefits, development opportunities, and an inclusive and safe work environment, we aim to create an organization our people are proud to represent.

**Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity & Inclusion**

At Emerson, we are committed to fostering a culture where every employee is valued and respected for their unique experiences and perspectives. We believe a diverse and inclusive work environment contributes to the rich exchange of ideas and diversity of thoughts, that inspires innovation and brings the best solutions to our customers.

This philosophy is fundamental to living our company’s values and our responsibility to leave the world in a better place. Learn more about our Culture & Values and about Diversity, Equity & Inclusion at Emerson .

title: Associate Applications Engineer
description:
**Job Description**
===================

Our clients need their systems to be reliable, secure, and available. As an Applications Engineer, you will help ensure that their applications and hosting environments run smoothly.

You will act as a bridge between our clients, technology, and engineering teams. You will understand client requirements, configure and deploy applications, troubleshoot technical issues, and support production environments.

This role is not limited to application support. It requires a combination of application support, troubleshooting, deployment, infrastructure knowledge, database skills, and basic coding/scripting knowledge. You will work with different technical teams to identify problems, implement solutions, automate repetitive tasks, and continuously improve application reliability.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

**Application Setup and Deployment**

* Install, configure, and deploy applications on servers and application services.

* Support application releases, code deployments, and environment setup.

* Handle client requests such as certificate installations, new sites, site updates, overwrites, and vanity URLs.

* Perform functional and integration testing before releases.

Support application configuration and environment-related changes.  



**Troubleshooting and Production Support**

* Investigate and resolve application errors, access issues, and performance problems.

* Analyze application and server logs to identify root causes.

* Monitor applications and servers and respond to production incidents.

* Troubleshoot issues across application, server, database, and network layers.

* Help maintain application availability, performance, and security.

Follow change management procedures for installations, upgrades, and maintenance activities.  



**Client and Team Collaboration**

* Act as a technical point of contact for clients and internal teams regarding hosting and application requests.

* Understand client requirements and communicate technical solutions clearly.

* Manage and prioritize cases in the hosting queue.

* Assign, update, and follow up on cases while keeping clients and hosting partners informed.

* Follow standard operating procedures (SOPs) when handling support cases.

* Review case backlogs and ensure timely updates and resolution.

Manage shared mailboxes and communication with hosting partners.  



**Technical Skills, Coding, and Automation**

* Work with APIs, databases, and other systems integrated with application.

* Use basic coding or scripting skills to troubleshoot issues and automate repetitive tasks.

* Write or modify simple scripts using technologies such as PowerShell, SQL, or other scripting languages.

* Develop automation where possible to improve application reliability and reduce manual effort.

Understand application configuration, web applications, and basic software development concepts.  



**Documentation and Continuous Improvement**

* Create and maintain SOPs, process documentation, and technical notes for client environments.

* Identify recurring issues and suggest improvements to processes and applications.

* Learn and support Momentive's association management products.

* Work closely with developers, DevOps, infrastructure, QA, and business teams.

* Participate in the rotational on-call support schedule.

**What You Bring**
------------------

* 1+ years of experience in application support, application implementation, or a similar technical role.

* Good understanding of application troubleshooting and production support.

* Working knowledge of Windows Server, IIS, Remote Desktop, and Domain Controllers.

* Experience with monitoring tools such as Nagios, CloudWatch, or Pingdom.

* Basic understanding of backups and recovery processes.

* Basic SQL Server knowledge, including writing and understanding simple SQL queries.

* Basic coding or scripting knowledge and the ability to understand or modify scripts.

* Experience with cloud-hosted applications or cloud environments.

* Experience using ticketing or IT service management systems.

* Knowledge of troubleshooting client environments, applications, servers, and networks.

* Experience supporting clients through phone, email, or ticketing systems.

* Understanding of change management and controlled deployment processes.

* Ability to analyze logs and troubleshoot technical issues systematically.

* Good communication and problem-solving skills.

* Engineering degree, MCA, MCM, or equivalent technical qualification.

**Nice to Have**
----------------

* AWS, Azure, or Microsoft certifications.

* PowerShell scripting experience.

* Knowledge of ITIL or Microsoft Operations Framework.

* Experience with change management tools.

* Experience monitoring and maintaining distributed applications or systems.

* Knowledge of security best practices and client data protection.

* Experience setting up websites and web applications.

* Basic understanding of firewalls, networking, DNS, and certificates.

* Experience working with APIs and application integrations.

**How You Work**
----------------

You build strong relationships with clients and colleagues and can work effectively both independently and as part of a team. You take ownership of issues, communicate clearly, and focus on delivering reliable solutions.

You are comfortable working on technical problems, learning new technologies, and going into the details when an issue is complex. You have a client-first mindset and are willing to support a rotational schedule and participate in on-call responsibilities.

**About Us**

Momentive Software amplifies the impact of over 20,000 purpose-driven organizations in over 30 countries, with over $11 billion raised and 55 million members served to date. Mission-driven nonprofits and associations rely on Momentive’s cloud-based software and services to address their most pressing challenges – from engaging their communities to simplifying operations and growing revenue. Designed to help organizations connect more, manage more, and ultimately expect more, Momentive's solutions are built with reliability at the core and strategically focus on fundraising, learning, events, careers, volunteering, accounting, and association management. Momentive partners with organizations that believe "good enough" is never enough – so they can bring on better outcomes for everyone they serve. Learn more at momentivesoftware.com .

title: NetScaler Engineer
description:
**Position Summary**
--------------------

The NetScaler Engineer owns the design, operation, and security of the Citrix NetScaler (formerly Citrix ADC) environment, with a primary focus on the NetScaler Gateway (Citrix Access Gateway) platform that gives employees and partners secure remote access to Citrix Virtual Apps and Desktops.

The role keeps remote access available, fast, and secure; resolves complex connectivity and authentication issues; and leads upgrades, patching, and improvements across the gateway estate.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

**Citrix Access Gateway Support (Primary Focus)**
-------------------------------------------------

* Administer, configure, and maintain NetScaler Gateway virtual servers for ICA proxy access to Citrix Virtual Apps and Desktops and Citrix Workspace.
* Integrate gateways with StoreFront and/or Citrix Cloud (Workspace), including session policies, profiles, callback URLs, and Secure Ticket Authority (STA) configuration.
* Build and support authentication flows using nFactor, LDAP/LDAPS, RADIUS, SAML, and multi-factor authentication providers such as Microsoft Entra ID, Okta, Duo, or RSA.
* Configure and troubleshoot Endpoint Analysis (EPA) scans, SmartAccess and SmartControl policies, and client certificate authentication.
* Serve as the escalation point for remote access incidents, including login failures, STA errors, session drops, HDX/EDT performance, and reconnect problems.
* Support HDX optimization through the gateway, including EDT (UDP/DTLS), Session Reliability, and audio/video for Microsoft Teams and softphone traffic.

**NetScaler Platform Operations**
---------------------------------

* Manage NetScaler BLX, CPX, VPX, MPX, and/or SDX appliances in high-availability pairs and clusters, including GSLB across data centers.
* Plan and execute firmware upgrades and emergency security patching, tracking vendor security bulletins and CVEs and applying fixes within defined SLAs.
* Manage SSL/TLS certificates, cipher groups, and SSL profiles; track renewals to prevent certificate-related gateway outages.
* Configure load balancing, content switching, responder, and rewrite policies for StoreFront, Director, and other internal services.
* Use NetScaler Console (formerly ADM), logs, and packet traces such as nstrace and Wireshark for monitoring, analytics, and root-cause analysis.
* Automate configuration and routine tasks with the NITRO API, PowerShell, Python, or Ansible/Terraform where practical.
* Migrate NetScalers from VMware ESXi clusters to Oracle OCI clusters.

**Security, Change Management & Documentation**
-----------------------------------------------

* Harden gateway configurations against current security baselines and support vulnerability scans, penetration tests, and audits.
* Follow change-management processes for all production changes, including test plans, rollback steps, and post-change validation.
* Maintain current architecture diagrams, runbooks, configuration standards, and disaster recovery procedures.
* Work with Citrix/VDI, Active Directory, identity, firewall, network, and service desk teams, and with vendor support on escalated cases.

 **Requirements**

* 5+ years of Hands-on experience deploying and troubleshooting NetScaler Gateway for Citrix Virtual Apps and Desktops (XenApp/XenDesktop) and StoreFront.
* Strong understanding of TCP/IP, DNS, SSL/TLS, PKI, HTTP, and load-balancing concepts.
* Experience with directory and identity integration, including Active Directory, LDAP, RADIUS, SAML, and MFA providers.
* Proficiency with packet-capture analysis and structured troubleshooting of authentication and connectivity issues.
* Experience with high-availability pair operations, firmware upgrades, and certificate lifecycle management.
* Clear written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain technical issues to non-technical users.
* Ability to overlap 5 hours with US Central time zone hours

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* Current NetScaler or Citrix networking certification, such as Citrix Certified Associate or Professional – Networking.
* Understanding of virtualization platforms such as VMware ESXi and Oracle OCI
* Experience with Citrix Cloud, Gateway Service, Cloud Connectors, and hybrid Citrix deployments.
* Experience with NetScaler Console (ADM), GSLB, and Web App Firewall (WAF).
* Scripting and automation experience with the NITRO API, PowerShell, Python, Ansible, or Terraform.
* Exposure to Zero Trust or ZTNA alternatives, such as Citrix Secure Private Access, and cloud platforms such as Azure or AWS.
* Experience in a regulated environment, such as healthcare (HIPAA) or finance.

title: Lead Solutions Architect
description:
Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI. At our core is the Celonis Context Model — which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence into a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can actually understand, turning AI's operational blind spots into operational clarity. World's leading companies trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. We believe there's a massive opportunity to unlock global productivity and sustainability by giving AI the context to understand how every business process really works. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet.

**The Team:**

Every Celonis outcome starts with data. As a Solutions Architect, you make sure our customers' data gets into the Celonis Platform reliably, securely, and at scale, and that insights and actions flow back out into the systems and AI tools where work actually happens.

**The Role:**

  

In this role you will work across diverse enterprise source systems such as SAP, Salesforce, and cloud databases, with a strong focus on the Oracle technology ecosystem. You will drive data extraction from Oracle environments (Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP, Oracle E-Business Suite, Oracle Database and Autonomous Database) and build integrations with Oracle's AI and automation infrastructure.

You will own complex, highly customized integration projects end to end, anticipate blockers before they surface, and shape the best long-term solution together with the customer and Celonis internal teams. You are a trusted technical advisor to customer IT, data, and security leaders, and a go-to partner for colleagues across Services, Product & Engineering, and Go-to-Market.

Beyond day-to-day delivery, you invest part of your time in growing the SA practice: building reusable assets, and driving small initiatives that advance team strategy, including our Oracle integration playbooks.

**The work you'll do:**

**Lead complex data integration and ingestion**

* Own Oracle data extraction. Architect and deliver ingestion from Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP, Oracle EBS R12, and Oracle Database / Autonomous Database, including JDBC and PL/SQL-based approaches, while understanding the underlying business processes in these systems.
* Build real-time and CDC integrations. Design change data capture and event-driven architectures using Oracle GoldenGate, Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC), Kafka, and REST/SOAP APIs, and use them to power Celonis Action Flows.
* Deliver Oracle ERP and other enterprise connections. Lead Oracle ERP connections or cloud based equivalents (e.g. via Oracle BICC). Deliver customized JDBC setups, including Dockerized and real-time configurations.
* Build and own custom API connectors. Design advanced connectors, including complex authentication, pagination, and delta loads, and advise on API design topics such as synchronous versus asynchronous APIs and OData.
* Architect push-based and lakehouse pipelines. Lead Python-based pipelines with Celonis data ingestion API with data engineering and SDLC best practices, and design Landing Zone and lakehouse solutions (for example Databricks, or Microsoft Fabric), including zero copy solutions.
* Solve hard infrastructure problems. Work with customer IT on DMZs, network bridges, WAFs, proxies, certificates, on-premise agent deployments, and Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) networking.
* Keep pipelines healthy. Tune extraction schedules and delta strategies, optimize database and pipeline performance (for example on Oracle DB and Exadata), and resolve data load failures so customers get timely, trustworthy data.

**Actions, automation, and AI connectivity**

* Deliver advanced writebacks and automation. Configure Action Flows with customized agent settings and direct API-based integrations, including writebacks into Oracle systems, and advise on bot integrations, permissioning, and security.
* Connect Celonis to enterprise AI. Design AI integration patterns that connect Celonis Orchestration and Action Flows with OCI Generative AI Agents, Oracle Select AI (Database 23ai), or Oracle Digital Assistant, and guide customers in connecting Celonis to their LLMs and AI agents through MCP, covering authentication, permissions, and governance.

**Identity, security, and governance**

* Own authentication and provisioning. Configure SSO (SAML, OIDC) with identity providers such as OCI IAM, Microsoft Entra ID, Okta, and Ping, and set up SCIM-based user and group provisioning.

* Excellent communication and storytelling across written, verbal, and slide formats, tailored to technical and executive audiences, and fluency in English.

Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI, empowering organizations to analyze, design, and operate AI-driven processes. The Celonis Platform is powered by the Celonis Context Model, which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence to create a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can understand — turning AI's operational blind spots into operational clarity. Industry-leading companies around the world trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. title: Service Operations Engineer
description:
**About Providence**
--------------------

Providence, one of the US’s largest not-for-profit healthcare systems, is committed to high quality, compassionate healthcare for all. Driven by the belief that health is a human right and the vision, ‘Health for a better world’, Providence and its 121,000 caregivers strive to provide everyone access to affordable quality care and services.

Providence has a network of 51 hospitals, 1,000+ care clinics, senior services, supportive housing, and other health and educational services in the US.

Providence India is bringing to fruition the transformational shift of the healthcare ecosystem to Health 2.0. The India center will have focused efforts around healthcare technology and innovation, and play a vital role in driving digital transformation of health systems for improved patient outcomes and experiences, caregiver efficiency, and running the business of Providence at scale.

  

**Why Us?**
-----------

* Best In-class Benefits
* Inclusive Leadership
* Reimagining Healthcare
* Competitive Pay
* Supportive Reporting Relation

About the Role

We are looking for a highly skilled and customer-focused Support Engineer to join our team. The support engineer is responsible for handling advanced support issues, resolving and triaging escalated technical problems. This role requires strong troubleshooting capabilities, excellent communication, and a deep understanding of IT infrastructure and end-user technologies

Our Team culture

* Work environment, which is collaborative and driven by learning, attention to details & empathy towards our caregivers
* Empowering & enabling individuals and teams to realize their full potential
* Focus on outcomes, solving our caregivers’ pain points & predictable delivery
* Data driven decision making on vision & roadmap of the Service Desk

What will you be responsible for

  

The ideal candidate will have a blend of technical, process & operational skills in service desk management, operations, customer interactions and call handling. The candidate should be skilled at applying her/ his experience with a focus on problem solving, supporting systems, operational excellence, service quality, reduction of manual toil with focus on End User experience. Candidate should be highly collaborative and has good working experience in Global operating setups.

Key Responsibilities

* **Customer Service**: Personal responsibility for customer satisfaction. Professionally represents the ‘Face and Voice of IT’ in difficult situations, consistently strives to listen, understand, and support the needs of others in a sensitive manner.
* **Quality**: Performs challenging tasks efficiently and effectively. Anticipates problems and takes corrective action prior to completing the task. Sets challenging objectives and works against self-defined standards of excellence to continually improve personal performance.
* **Problem Solving**: Strong attention to detail and outstanding analytical skills.
* Collaboration: Ability to work effectively to build relationships with colleagues, customers, and management through positive interaction.
* **Flexibility and response to change**: Proven ability to organize multiple efforts and to respond to shifting priorities. Demonstrated ability to study, understand, adapt, and respond effectively to a constantly changing environment.
* **Communications**: Listens with sensitivity and openness. Actively seeks constructive feedback and remains open and receptive to it. Anticipates the information needs of others. Proven skills in communicating with clinical and technical customers.
  

What would your day look like?

* Handle incidents and service requests escalated from Tier 1 support via ITSM tools (e.g., ServiceNow)
* Troubleshoot and resolve hardware, software, and network issues for end users.
* Provide support for Windows/Mac OS, Microsoft 365, VPN, printers, mobile devices, and collaboration tools.
* Identify area of opportunity for latest Knowledge Articles towards enhanced FCR (First Call Resolution) and supportability.
* Ensure production solutions are reliable, secure, and effective and that implemented solutions are continuously monitored and documented. Look for opportunities to Left Shift and Right Shift tickets to reduce overall customer pain points, manual toil, and cost per ticket.
* Execute operational excellence, tracking metrics and KPIs to drive governance, quality, and efficiency. Influence and improve existing processes through innovative behaviors and effective change management.
* Perform Data Quality Audit on Incident logging. Suggest required changes towards deriving incident patterns and trends.
* Perform monthly Incident Pattern and Theme analysis.
* Execute opportunities and drive automation to improve KPIs on ticket reduction, ticket cycle time and resolution rate.
* Perform administrative tasks and troubleshooting in the following environments including Citrix, Active Directory, Single Sign-On services, E-mail Exchange, Patient electronic health records and other applications as needed.
* Support Active Directory tasks: password resets, user account management, group policy troubleshooting.
* Manage remote access and connectivity issues (e.g., Citrix, VPN, RDP).
* Escalate unresolved incidents to Tier 2 or specialized teams with detailed documentation.
* Follow ITIL best practices for incident, problem, and change management.

Who are we looking for?

* 1-3 years of Industry experience in Service Management, Service Operations, IT Service Desk Operations
* Good Communications skills (Fluent English)
* Flexibility to work in 24\*7 work environment
* ITIL v4/v5 Foundation certification (Preferred)
* Required Skills: M365, Basic Network overview, Power BI, SQL
* Experience with Active Directory and ITSM tools
* BE/B-Tech or Equivalent degree.

title: Network Architect
description:
Candescent is a forward-thinking technology company transforming how financial institutions deliver Intelligent Banking experiences. We unite digital banking, account opening, and branch solutions that power and connect digital banking, account opening, and branch solutions—creating seamless engagement across digital, remote, and in-person channels.

Our Experience-Led, Intelligence-Driven approach combines human-centered design with data, automation, and cloud-based innovation. Built on an API-first architecture, our extensible ecosystem enables institutions to adapt quickly, integrate easily, and unlock new opportunities for growth—turning every customer interaction into a moment of clarity, confidence, and connection.

**Position Summary**

Candescent is seeking an experienced and innovative **Network Architect** to lead the design, strategy, and evolution of our enterprise network infrastructure. This role is responsible for developing scalable, secure, and resilient network architectures that support corporate offices, cloud environments, financial institution operations, and emerging business initiatives.

The Network Architect will partner closely with Infrastructure, Security, Cloud Engineering, Application Development, and Operations teams to define technology roadmaps, establish engineering standards, and drive modernization initiatives. This position serves as the highest level of technical authority for enterprise networking and provides guidance for complex projects, strategic investments, and operational excellence.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Enterprise Network Architecture**

* Develop and maintain the enterprise network architecture roadmap.
* Design highly available, scalable, and secure LAN, WAN, WLAN, SD-WAN, Cloud and B2B Networking and internet edge solutions.
* Create and maintain high-level and low-level network designs, standards, and reference architectures.
* Evaluate existing environments and recommend improvements aligned with business objectives.
* Establish networking standards and governance for all Candescent locations and hosted environments.

**Cloud & Hybrid Networking**

* Design connectivity solutions for Azure, AWS,GCP (Must Have) and hybrid cloud deployments.
* Define architectures for cloud transit networking, DNS, routing, security segmentation, and application delivery.
* Lead cloud networking initiatives on secure multi-cloud connectivity.
* Collaborate with cloud engineering teams on network automation and infrastructure-as-code initiatives.

**Security Architecture & Compliance**

* Partner with Information Security teams to design secure network solutions.
* Develop architectures supporting Zero Trust, network segmentation, NAC, SASE, ZTNA, and secure remote access.
* Ensure designs meet regulatory and compliance requirements including FFIEC, PCI-DSS, SOX, and corporate security standards.
* Provide technical leadership during security assessments, audits, and risk reviews.

**Strategic Leadership**

* Provide architectural oversight for major infrastructure projects.
* Lead technology evaluations, proof-of-concepts, and vendor assessments.
* Develop multi-year network technology roadmaps and lifecycle management strategies.
* Influence infrastructure direction through innovation and industry best practices.
* Present architectural recommendations to senior leadership and executive stakeholders.

**Operational Excellence**

* Act as the highest escalation point for complex networking issues.
* Review network performance, capacity, resiliency, and availability metrics.
* Guide disaster recovery and business continuity planning efforts.
* Ensure infrastructure designs align with operational supportability requirements.

**Automation & Modernization**

* Promote network automation and orchestration strategies.
* Design solutions utilizing APIs, scripting, and infrastructure-as-code platforms.
* Drive adoption of modern operational models and observability platforms.
* Partner with engineering teams to implement automated provisioning and configuration management.

**Mentorship & Collaboration**

* Mentor Network Engineers and Senior Engineers on architecture and design principles.
* Participate in technical reviews, change advisory boards, and project governance.
* Foster technical excellence across Infrastructure Engineering teams.
* Build strong partnerships with business units, application owners, vendors, and managed service providers.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related discipline.
* 10+ years of enterprise networking experience.
* 5+ years designing large-scale, mission-critical network environments.
* Expert level experience with:
  + GCP Networking
  + Cloud and B2B Networking
  + Palo Alto Networks firewalls
  + Meraki Wireless networking technologies
  + SD-WAN solutions
* Strong experience designing:
  + Fortigate Network firewalls
  + Corporate office networks
  + Hybrid cloud connectivity
  + Individual Financial Institution Networks
* Experience with network security architecture and segmentation strategies.
* Proven ability to lead large-scale infrastructure transformation projects.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Financial services or regulated industry experience.
* Experience with:
  + Cisco Wireless / Meraki
  + Palo Alto Networks & SCM
  + Azure networking
  + AWS networking
  + GCP networking (Must Have)
  + Prisma Access
  + Network automation platforms
* Knowledge of infrastructure-as-code frameworks.
* Experience with monitoring and observability platforms.
* Strong written documentation and presentation skills.

**Certifications (Nice To Have)**

* Palo Alto Networks Certified Network Security Architect (PCNSA/PCNSE)
* Professional Cloud Network Engineer (PCNE)
* AWS Advanced Networking Specialty
* Microsoft Azure Network Engineer Associate
* Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP)

**Success Metrics**

The successful Network Architect will:

* Establish enterprise architecture standards and governance.
* Improve network reliability, resiliency, and security posture.
* Reduce operational complexity through standardization and automation.
* Lead infrastructure modernization initiatives.
* Support business growth through scalable network design.
* Serve as the trusted technical advisor for network strategy across Candescent.

**Statement to Third Party Agencies**  
To ALL recruitment agencies: Candescent only accepts resumes from agencies on the preferred supplier list. Please do not forward resumes to our applicant tracking system, Candescent employees, or any Candescent facility. Candescent is not responsible for any fees or charges associated with unsolicited resumes.

title: Senior Associate System Engineer
description:
As a Senior Associate System Engineer in the Upgrade Center Integrated Technologies team, you will deliver customer upgrade services for Oracle’s CareAware product suite, including hardware and software deployments, cloud migrations, and clinical workflow consulting. You will collaborate with customers on new, add-on, and optimization deployments of integrated clinical devices, including lab analyzers, anesthesia systems, patient monitors, ventilators, infusion pumps, and medication dispensing cabinets. Responsibilities include supporting project events, testing calls, status meetings, and conversions; following implementation and upgrade best practices; troubleshooting device integration issues; and partnering with engagement management to assess risks and mitigate findings throughout customer engagements.

  

**Duties and Responsibilities:**

* Consult with customers on technical design decisions, infrastructure requirements, and deployment architecture.
* Conduct remote technical training for Clinical Informatics, IT, Lab Analysts, and Biomedical Engineering teams.
* Adhere to established processes, methodologies, and best practices for technical implementations and documentation.
* Advise on deployment strategies, design impacts, cloud readiness, and migration requirements.
* Plan and execute cloud migrations and deployments, including environment configuration, connectivity validation, testing, cutover, and rollback planning.
* Collaborate with client networking and security teams to define and validate firewall rules, required ports and protocols, routing, DNS, VPN connectivity, and network segmentation.
* Troubleshoot connectivity issues across clinical devices, on-premises infrastructure, and cloud environments.
* Provide client support outside standard business hours as needed.
* Establish and maintain effective client relationships and a high level of client satisfaction.
* Coordinate technical planning and implementation activities across multiple customers.
* Manage multiple work assignments to meet project commitments and utilization targets.
* Develop and maintain knowledge of CareAware Device Integration products and services.
* Consult with customers and internal teams on the deployment and integration of hardware, software, cloud infrastructure, and services.
* Collaborate with third-party vendors and partners to resolve integration and deployment dependencies.
* Complete hardware and software installations, configurations, and upgrades for customers.
* Support and validate client software functionality following installations, upgrades, and migrations.
* Perform technical troubleshooting and issue resolution, escalating issues as appropriate.
* Serve as an escalation point for non-production issues across supported products and triage issues to Support Management as appropriate.

title: Senior OT Systems Onboarding & Migration Lead Role
description:
**Senior OT Systems Onboarding & Migration Lead**
-------------------------------------------------

**Role overview**

We’re looking for an experienced OT professional to lead the assessment, onboarding, and migration planning of operational technology systems into the environment. You’ll work with site teams, engineering groups, vendors, and infrastructure specialists to develop practical plans for both new and legacy OT systems, while protecting operational continuity and supporting secure, standardized environments.

**What you’ll do**
------------------

* Lead OT system assessments and develop onboarding and migration plans for greenfield and brownfield environments.
* Work with system owners, automation engineers, laboratory managers, manufacturing stakeholders, and vendors to understand system architectures, dependencies, constraints, and readiness.
* Advise sites on migration prerequisites, risks, validation impacts, operational readiness, and execution planning.
* Facilitate workshops to agree onboarding approaches, migration strategies, and target-state architectures.
* Explain requirements to technical and non-technical stakeholders, serving as their primary technical contact throughout onboarding.
* Coordinate with service lines and delivery teams on infrastructure and service needs, including secure networks, segmentation, Active Directory, endpoint protection, remote access, servers, virtualization, storage, and file shares.
* Help resolve technical blockers, service requests, and infrastructure dependencies that affect onboarding schedules.
* Support modernization initiatives such as Windows and domain upgrades, hardware refreshes, virtualization, and network redesign.
* Identify opportunities to reduce cyber risk and technical debt while minimizing disruption to manufacturing, laboratory, and other operational environments.

 **Requirements**  

**What you’ll bring**
---------------------

* 8+ years of experience in Operational Technology, Industrial Automation, Manufacturing IT/OT, Process Control, Laboratory Systems, or OT Cybersecurity.
* Experience supporting brownfield OT migrations, infrastructure upgrades, or industrial modernization programmes.
* Strong understanding of industrial control systems, manufacturing or laboratory platforms, and supporting OT infrastructure.
* Experience working with automation vendors, OEMs, system integrators, and engineering teams.
* Familiarity with industrial networking, Active Directory, virtualization, Windows platforms, firewall-based LAN segmentation, and cybersecurity technologies.
* Strong technical problem-solving, stakeholder engagement, and coordination skills.
* Ability to manage complex technical activities across multiple teams and service providers.

**Preferred experience**
------------------------

* Experience in pharmaceutical, biotechnology, life sciences, or regulated manufacturing environments.
* Familiarity with SCADA, DCS, PLC, MES, laboratory systems, historian platforms, or manufacturing execution environments.
* Experience with OT network segmentation, secure architecture programmes, or integrating legacy and vendor-managed systems into standardized enterprise infrastructure.
* Understanding of GMP qualification and validation processes.
* Experience contributing to large-scale global infrastructure or cybersecurity transformation programmes.

title: Cyber Security & Infrastructure Engineer
description:
**About the Role**

We are looking for a proactive Cyber Security & Infrastructure Engineer with 1.5 years or more of relevant experience in IT infrastructure, cybersecurity operations, network security, system administration, and security monitoring. The candidate will help maintain a secure and reliable technology environment by implementing security controls, monitoring infrastructure, managing vulnerabilities, and supporting applicable regulatory and audit requirements.

**Key ResponsibilitiesCybersecurity Operations**

* Monitor security alerts, system logs, and suspicious activities to identify potential threats.
* Support vulnerability assessments, penetration testing coordination, and remediation tracking.
* Help protect sensitive customer information, personally identifiable information (PII), and financial data.
* Support endpoint protection (antivirus/EDR), firewall, and intrusion detection/prevention controls.
* Assist with security incident investigation, documentation, escalation, and root cause analysis.
* Support Data Loss Prevention (DLP) controls to reduce unauthorized data sharing or transfers.

**IT Infrastructure & Network Security**

* Administer and monitor servers, operating systems, network devices, and cloud infrastructure.
* Support firewall rules, VPNs, access controls, network segmentation, and secure remote access.
* Perform system hardening, security patching, and operating system updates.
* Monitor infrastructure availability, performance, backups, and security configurations.
* Support cloud security and identity/access management in platforms such as Oracle Cloud, AWS, or Azure.
* Assist with backup, disaster recovery (DR), and business continuity (BCP) activities.

**Identity & Access Management**

* Manage user access provisioning, modification, and deactivation based on approved requests.
* Support role-based access control (RBAC), least privilege, and multi-factor authentication (MFA).
* Conduct periodic access reviews and identify inactive, excessive, or privileged access.

**Security Compliance & Audit**

* Support cybersecurity and IT control requirements applicable to an RBI-regulated NBFC.
* Assist with internal/external audits, VAPT, evidence collection, and audit response.
* Maintain asset inventories, access review records, patch reports, incident logs, and security documentation.
* Track audit observations and coordinate timely remediation with relevant teams and vendors.

**Monitoring, Reporting & Incident Response**

* Monitor events using available SIEM, EDR, firewall, and infrastructure monitoring tools.
* Escalate critical security incidents and infrastructure issues promptly.
* Prepare periodic reports on vulnerabilities, patch compliance, access reviews, security alerts, and infrastructure health.
* Coordinate with development, infrastructure, and third-party vendor teams to resolve security issues.

**Required Technical Skills**

* **Networking:** TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, VPNs, routing, and firewall fundamentals.
* **Operating Systems:** Windows Server and Linux administration.
* **Security Tools:** Exposure to firewalls, antivirus/EDR, vulnerability scanners, and SIEM platforms.
* **Infrastructure:** Server administration, patch management, backup solutions, and basic cloud security.
* **Security Fundamentals:** Vulnerability management, system hardening, access control, incident response, and log analysis.
* **Cloud Platforms:** Basic knowledge of Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI), AWS, or Microsoft Azure.
* **Scripting:** Basic Python, PowerShell, or Bash scripting is an advantage.
* **Documentation:** Ability to maintain technical documentation, security reports, and audit evidence.

**Qualifications & Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree or diploma in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or a related field.
* Minimum 1.5 years of relevant experience in cybersecurity, IT infrastructure, network administration, or information security operations.
* Certifications such as CompTIA Security+, CCNA, Microsoft Security, or cloud security certifications are preferred, not mandatory.

**Preferred Candidate Profile**

* Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
* Understanding of confidentiality and secure handling of customer information.
* Ability to coordinate with internal teams, auditors, and external technology vendors.
* Proactive approach to identifying and resolving security risks.
* Good communication, documentation, and incident reporting skills.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* Timely identification, tracking, and remediation of vulnerabilities.
* Security patch compliance across servers and endpoints.
* Timely closure of security audit observations.
* Completion of access reviews and appropriate privileged account controls.
* Timely detection, escalation, and documentation of security incidents.
* Monitoring of backup jobs and participation in recovery tests.
* Adherence to approved security policies and infrastructure hardening standards.

**Note:** The role supports the organization’s cybersecurity and infrastructure controls in line with applicable regulatory requirements, internal policies, and the organization’s risk profile.

Pay: ₹400,000.00 - ₹800,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule
* Health insurance

* Paid time off
* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person

description:
**About Providence**
--------------------

Providence, one of the US’s largest not-for-profit healthcare systems, is committed to high quality, compassionate healthcare for all. Driven by the belief that health is a human right and the vision, ‘Health for a better world’, Providence and its 121,000 caregivers strive to provide everyone access to affordable quality care and services.

Providence has a network of 51 hospitals, 1,000+ care clinics, senior services, supportive housing, and other health and educational services in the US.

Providence India is bringing to fruition the transformational shift of the healthcare ecosystem to Health 2.0. The India center will have focused efforts around healthcare technology and innovation, and play a vital role in driving digital transformation of health systems for improved patient outcomes and experiences, caregiver efficiency, and running the business of Providence at scale.

-----------

* Inclusive Leadership

The Tier 1.5 Engineer is responsible for handling advanced support issues, resolving escalated technical problems, and serving as the point of contact between Tier 1 support and specialized IT teams. This role requires strong troubleshooting capabilities, excellent communication, and a deep understanding of IT infrastructure and end-user technologies

Our Team culture

* Work environment, which is collaborative and driven by learning, attention to details & empathy towards our caregivers
* Empowering & enabling individuals and teams to realize their full potential
* Focus on outcomes, solving our caregivers’ pain points & predictable delivery

The candidate should be skilled at applying her/ his experience with a focus on problem solving, supporting systems, operational excellence, service quality, reduction of manual toil with focus on End User experience. The candidate should be highly collaborative and has good working experience in Global operating setups.

  

Key Responsibilities

* **Customer Service**: Personal responsibility for customer satisfaction. Professionally represents the ‘Face and Voice of IT’ in difficult situations, consistently strives to listen, understand, and support the needs of others in a sensitive manner.
* **Quality**: Performs challenging tasks efficiently and effectively. Anticipates problems and takes corrective action prior to completing the task. Sets challenging objectives and works against self-defined standards of excellence to continually improve personal performance.

* **Collaboration**: Ability to work effectively to build relationships with colleagues, customers, and management through positive interaction.

* **Communications**: Listens with sensitivity and openness. Actively seeks constructive feedback and remains open and receptive to it. Anticipates the information needs of others. Proven skills in communicating with clinical and technical customers.

* Perform Data Quality Audit on Incident logging. Suggest required changes towards deriving incident patterns and trends.
* Perform monthly Incident Pattern and Theme analysis.
* Execute opportunities and drive automation to improve KPIs on ticket reduction, ticket cycle time and resolution rate.
* Perform administrative tasks and troubleshooting in the following environments including Citrix, Active Directory, Single Sign-On services, E-mail Exchange, Patient electronic health records and other applications as needed.
* Support Active Directory tasks: password resets, user account management, group policy troubleshooting.
* Manage remote access and connectivity issues (e.g., Citrix, VPN, RDP).
* Perform root cause analysis for recurring issues and document resolutions.
* Escalate unresolved incidents to Tier 3 or specialized teams with detailed documentation.
* Follow ITIL best practices for incident, problem, and change management.
* Support software deployments, updates, patching, and imaging of systems.

Who are we looking for?

* 5-8 years of Industry experience in Service Management, Service Desk Operations
* Good Communications skills (Fluent English)
* Flexibility to work in 24\*7 work environment
* ITIL v4/v5 Foundation certification (Preferred)
* Required Skills: MS Outlook, Word, Excel, Internet, Power BI, SQL
* Experience with Active Directory, M365 and ITSM

description:
**About Providence**
--------------------

Providence, one of the US’s largest not-for-profit healthcare systems, is committed to high quality, compassionate healthcare for all. Driven by the belief that health is a human right and the vision, ‘Health for a better world’, Providence and its 121,000 caregivers strive to provide everyone access to affordable quality care and services.

Providence has a network of 51 hospitals, 1,000+ care clinics, senior services, supportive housing, and other health and educational services in the US.

Providence India is bringing to fruition the transformational shift of the healthcare ecosystem to Health 2.0. The India center will have focused efforts around healthcare technology and innovation, and play a vital role in driving digital transformation of health systems for improved patient outcomes and experiences, caregiver efficiency, and running the business of Providence at scale.

  

**Why Us?**
-----------

* Best In-class Benefits
* Inclusive Leadership
* Reimagining Healthcare
* Competitive Pay
* Supportive Reporting Relation

About the Role

We are looking for a highly skilled and customer-focused Support Engineer to join our team. The support engineer is responsible for handling advanced support issues, resolving and triaging escalated technical problems. This role requires strong troubleshooting capabilities, excellent communication, and a deep understanding of IT infrastructure and end-user technologies

Our Team culture

* Work environment, which is collaborative and driven by learning, attention to details & empathy towards our caregivers
* Empowering & enabling individuals and teams to realize their full potential
* Focus on outcomes, solving our caregivers’ pain points & predictable delivery
* Data driven decision making on vision & roadmap of the Service Desk

What will you be responsible for

  

The ideal candidate will have a blend of technical, process & operational skills in service desk management, operations, customer interactions and call handling. The candidate should be skilled at applying her/ his experience with a focus on problem solving, supporting systems, operational excellence, service quality, reduction of manual toil with focus on End User experience. Candidate should be highly collaborative and has good working experience in Global operating setups.

Key Responsibilities

* **Customer Service**: Personal responsibility for customer satisfaction. Professionally represents the ‘Face and Voice of IT’ in difficult situations, consistently strives to listen, understand, and support the needs of others in a sensitive manner.
* **Quality**: Performs challenging tasks efficiently and effectively. Anticipates problems and takes corrective action prior to completing the task. Sets challenging objectives and works against self-defined standards of excellence to continually improve personal performance.
* **Problem Solving**: Strong attention to detail and outstanding analytical skills.
* Collaboration: Ability to work effectively to build relationships with colleagues, customers, and management through positive interaction.
* **Flexibility and response to change**: Proven ability to organize multiple efforts and to respond to shifting priorities. Demonstrated ability to study, understand, adapt, and respond effectively to a constantly changing environment.
* **Communications**: Listens with sensitivity and openness. Actively seeks constructive feedback and remains open and receptive to it. Anticipates the information needs of others. Proven skills in communicating with clinical and technical customers.
  

What would your day look like?

* Handle incidents and service requests escalated from Tier 1 support via ITSM tools (e.g., ServiceNow)
* Troubleshoot and resolve hardware, software, and network issues for end users.
* Provide support for Windows/Mac OS, Microsoft 365, VPN, printers, mobile devices, and collaboration tools.
* Identify area of opportunity for latest Knowledge Articles towards enhanced FCR (First Call Resolution) and supportability.
* Ensure production solutions are reliable, secure, and effective and that implemented solutions are continuously monitored and documented. Look for opportunities to Left Shift and Right Shift tickets to reduce overall customer pain points, manual toil, and cost per ticket.
* Execute operational excellence, tracking metrics and KPIs to drive governance, quality, and efficiency. Influence and improve existing processes through innovative behaviors and effective change management.
* Perform Data Quality Audit on Incident logging. Suggest required changes towards deriving incident patterns and trends.
* Perform monthly Incident Pattern and Theme analysis.
* Execute opportunities and drive automation to improve KPIs on ticket reduction, ticket cycle time and resolution rate.
* Perform administrative tasks and troubleshooting in the following environments including Citrix, Active Directory, Single Sign-On services, E-mail Exchange, Patient electronic health records and other applications as needed.
* Support Active Directory tasks: password resets, user account management, group policy troubleshooting.
* Manage remote access and connectivity issues (e.g., Citrix, VPN, RDP).
* Escalate unresolved incidents to Tier 2 or specialized teams with detailed documentation.
* Follow ITIL best practices for incident, problem, and change management.

Who are we looking for?

* 3-5 years of Industry experience in Service Management, Service Operations, IT Service Desk Operations
* Good Communications skills (Fluent English)
* Flexibility to work in 24\*7 work environment
* ITIL v4/v5 Foundation certification (Preferred)
* Required Skills: MS Outlook, Word, Excel, Internet, Power BI, SQL
* Experience with Active Directory, Microsoft 365, and ITSM tools
* BE/B-Tech or Equivalent degree.

Providence’s vision to create ‘Health for a Better World’ aids us to provide a fair and equitable workplace for all in our employment, whether temporary, part-time or full time, and to promote individuality and diversity of thought and background, and acknowledge its role in the organization’s success. This makes us committed towards equal employment opportunities, regardless of race, religion or belief, color, ancestry, disability, marital status, gender, sexual orientation, age, nationality, ethnic origin, pregnancy, or related needs, mental or sensory disability, HIV Status, or any other category protected by applicable law. In furtherance to our mission in building a more inclusive and equitable environment, we shall, from time to time, undertake programs to assist, uplift and empower underrepresented groups including but not limited to Women, PWD (Persons with Disabilities), LGTBQ+ (Lesbian, Gay, Transgender, Bisexual or Queer), Veterans and others. We strive to address all forms of discrimination or harassment and provide a safe and confidential process to report any misconduct.

Contact our Integrity hotline also, read our Code of Conduct.

title: Engineer II / Senior Civil and Pipeline Engineer
description:
**Overview**
------------

We are seeking a highly skilled Civil & Pipeline Engineer to join our Water Infrastructure team and lead the delivery of major pipeline and utility projects across water and wastewater networks. This role is ideal for a technical leader with extensive experience in the planning, design, and delivery of large-diameter transmission pipelines, trunk mains, rising mains, utility diversions, and associated civil infrastructure. The successful candidate will play a key role in developing resilient water networks, improving asset performance, and delivering sustainable engineering solutions for utility clients. Working as part of a multidisciplinary engineering team, you will be responsible for driving technically challenging projects from feasibility and concept development through detailed design, procurement support, and construction.

**Your Role**
-------------

  

* Lead the design and delivery of strategic water transmission pipelines, trunk mains, rising mains, gravity sewers, and utility infrastructure projects.
* Develop pipeline alignments, route selection studies, utility coordination strategies, and constructability assessments.
* Design and review large-diameter buried pipelines, valve chambers, flow control structures, utility crossings, and associated civil infrastructure.
* Lead design activities required for utility surveys, clash assessments, diversion designs, easement requirements.
* Support or lead hydraulic modelling of water, wastewater, and stormwater networks using tools such as WaterGEMS, SewerGEMS, or similar software.
* Support network planning, capacity assessments, flood risk studies, resilience improvements, and infrastructure investment decisions.
* Utilize GIS platforms such as ArcGIS Pro, ArcGIS Online, QGIS, or MapInfo for route selection, spatial analysis, utility mapping, catchment studies, and infrastructure planning.
* Coordinate multidisciplinary teams comprising Civil, Structural, Mechanical, Electrical, ICA, Geotechnical, and BIM professionals.
* Provide technical governance through design reviews, risk assessments, quality assurance, and value engineering initiatives.
* Support project delivery during procurement and construction by resolving technical issues and providing engineering guidance.
* Contribute to bid preparation, technical proposals, and client relationship management.
* Mentor engineers and support the development of pipeline and utility design capability across the business.

**About You**
-------------

*Qualifications & Skills*

* Mandatory bachelor's degree in civil engineering.
* Work experience of 8 years or more
* Significant experience in water and wastewater pipeline engineering and utility infrastructure design.

*Strong expertise in*

* Large-diameter water transmission mains
* Trunk sewers and rising mains
* Utility diversion and coordination projects
* Buried infrastructure and pipeline corridor design
* Utility protection and asset management requirements
* Pumping stations and associated network infrastructure
* Pipeline hydraulics and route optimization studies
* Design management and multidisciplinary coordination
* Construction support and buildability reviews

*You will also demonstrate*

* Experience delivering projects through feasibility, concept, detailed design, and construction support stages.
* Experience in hydraulic modelling for water, wastewater, or stormwater networks.
* Proficiency in GIS software and geospatial data analysis.
* Understanding of UK water industry standards and project delivery practices.
* Experience with trenchless technologies such as HDD, pipe jacking, or micro-tunnelling would be advantageous.
* Excellent stakeholder management and client-facing communication skills.
* Proven ability to lead multidisciplinary engineering teams and manage complex technical interfaces.
* Experience working on major water utility frameworks and infrastructure programmes.
* Chartered Engineer status, or a commitment to achieving chartership, would be advantageous.

**Rewards & Benefits**
----------------------

Explore the rewards and benefits that help you thrive – at every stage of your life and your career.

This includes:

* Comprehensive life insurance coverage.
* Premium medical insurance for you and your dependents.
* Generous annual leave balance.
* Flexible and hybrid work solutions.
* Remote work opportunities outside of country.
* Company gratuity scheme.
* Discretionary bonus program.
* Relocation assistance.
* Employee Wellbeing Program: 24/7 access to specialists in finance, legal matters, family care, personal health, fitness, and nutrition.

Seize every opportunity to sharpen your skills, expand your expertise, and be recognized for the impact you make.

**About AtkinsRéalis**
----------------------

We're AtkinsRéalis, a world-class engineering services and nuclear organization. We connect people, data and technology to transform the world's'infrastructure and energy systems. Together, with our industry partners and clients, and our global team of consultants, designers, engineers and project managers, we can change the world. We're committed to leading our clients across our various end markets to engineer a better future for our planet and its people.

title: IT Technical Intern
description:
Overview:

We are looking for a motivated, detail-oriented, and technically curious IT Technical Intern to join our Information Technology team. The intern will gain hands-on experience in IT support, systems administration, troubleshooting, networking, cybersecurity, hardware and software management, documentation, and technology operations while collaborating with IT professionals and business users.  
Our intent is to develop an IT professional who can understand the organization’s technology environment end to end, translate user and business requirements into practical technical solutions, resolve issues efficiently, support reliable IT operations, and contribute to the continuous improvement of systems, processes, and security practices.

Responsibilities:

* Understand the organization’s IT infrastructure, systems, applications, networks, devices, users, technical requirements, dependencies, and operational challenges.
* Assist in providing first-level technical support to employees and users through ticketing systems, email, chat, phone, or in-person support.
* Troubleshoot hardware, software, operating system, network, connectivity, access, printing, and application-related issues.
* Install, configure, maintain, and support computers, laptops, mobile devices, peripherals, operating systems, and business applications.
* Assist with user account provisioning, access management, password resets, permissions, onboarding, offboarding, and identity-related tasks.
* Support Microsoft 365, Google Workspace, collaboration tools, enterprise applications, and other productivity platforms, as applicable.
* Monitor IT systems, services, devices, and alerts and escalate incidents or risks according to established procedures.
* Assist with network troubleshooting involving TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VPNs, Wi-Fi, firewalls, switches, routers, and related infrastructure.
* Maintain accurate records of hardware, software, licenses, warranties, configurations, users, and IT assets.
* Use IT service management and ticketing tools to document incidents, service requests, troubleshooting steps, resolutions, and follow-up actions.
* Assist with software deployment, patching, updates, endpoint configuration, backups, and routine maintenance activities.
* Support cybersecurity practices such as endpoint protection, access control, phishing awareness, vulnerability remediation, secure configuration, and incident reporting.
* Follow established IT policies, procedures, change management practices, security controls, and data protection requirements.
* Assist with system administration tasks across Windows, Linux, cloud platforms, virtual machines, or other environments, as applicable to the assigned team.
* Use scripting or automation tools such as PowerShell, Python, Bash, or similar technologies to improve repetitive IT processes and operational efficiency.
* Investigate recurring technical issues, identify root causes, and recommend improvements to systems, documentation, workflows, and user experience.
* Contribute to IT projects such as system upgrades, migrations, deployments, infrastructure improvements, asset refreshes, and technology evaluations.
* Explore the responsible use of AI tools, automation, and intelligent assistants for IT support, documentation, troubleshooting, monitoring, and knowledge management.
* Evaluate AI-generated recommendations and outputs for accuracy, security, privacy, reliability, and alignment with organizational policies.
* Create and maintain technical documentation, knowledge base articles, standard operating procedures, user guides, network diagrams, and troubleshooting references.
* Communicate technical information clearly to both technical and non-technical users and provide professional, timely, and customer-focused support.

  
Qualifications:

Required Qualifications

* Currently pursuing or recently completed a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Information Systems, Cybersecurity, Network Engineering, or a related field.
* Basic understanding of computer hardware, operating systems, networking concepts, troubleshooting methodologies, and IT service management principles.
* Knowledge of programming fundamentals and design algorithms.
* Working knowledge of at least one operating system, such as Windows, Linux, or macOS.
* Foundational understanding of TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VPNs, Wi-Fi, user accounts, access permissions, and common enterprise IT services.
* Basic familiarity with productivity applications, collaboration tools, cloud services, endpoint devices, and software installation or configuration.
* Ability to diagnose problems logically, research solutions, follow procedures, document work accurately, and escalate issues appropriately.
* Strong attention to detail, customer service orientation, ownership, curiosity, collaboration skills, and willingness to learn and accept feedback.
* Understanding of basic cybersecurity, data privacy, password security, phishing risks, and responsible handling of confidential information.

Nice to have Skills :

* Hands-on experience supporting Windows, Linux, macOS, mobile devices, printers, scanners, and other IT equipment.
* Familiarity with Microsoft 365, Azure, Active Directory, Entra ID, Google Workspace, or similar enterprise platforms.
* Exposure to IT service management tools such as ServiceNow, Jira Service Management, Freshservice, Zendesk, or similar platforms.
* Familiarity with networking tools, command-line utilities, remote support tools, monitoring platforms, or diagnostic utilities.
* Experience with PowerShell, Python, Bash, batch scripting, or other automation and scripting technologies.
* Exposure to endpoint management, mobile device management, patch management, software deployment, or configuration management tools.
* Familiarity with cybersecurity tools and practices, including endpoint protection, vulnerability scanning, identity and access management, security monitoring, and incident response.
* Exposure to cloud platforms such as Microsoft Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud.
* Familiarity with virtualization, containers, backup systems, storage, servers, or infrastructure monitoring.
* Experience creating technical documentation, knowledge base articles, process guides, diagrams, or user training materials.
* Exposure to AI assistants, automation tools, prompt engineering, or AI-enabled IT support and knowledge management workflows.

**WHO WE ARE**

Shure’s mission is to be the most trusted audio brand worldwide – and for over a century, our Core Values have aligned us to be just that. Founded in 1925, we are a leading global manufacturer of audio equipment known for quality, reliability, and durability. We engineer microphones, headphones, wireless audio systems, conferencing systems, and more. And quality doesn’t stop at our products. Our talented teams strive for perfection and innovate every chance they get. We offer an Associate-first culture, flexible work arrangements, and opportunity for all.

Shure is headquartered in United States. We have more than 35 regional sales offices, engineering hubs, distribution centers and manufacturing facilities throughout the Americas, EMEA, and Asia.

Join Shure and **Amplify Your Impact.** Explore our unique culture and learn the key pillars that define our legacy of excellence.

**THE MIX MATTERS**

Don’t check off every box in the job requirements? No problem! We recognize that every professional journey is unique and are committed to providing an equitable candidate experience for all prospective Shure Associates. If you’re excited about this role, believe you’ve got the skills to be successful, and share our passion for creating an inclusive, diverse, equitable, and accessible work environment, then apply!

Leverages technology product stack across Microsoft platform predominantly to develop, enhance and maintain the best in class applications. The R & D division delivers solutions for the title insurance industry leveraging the best of NLP, AI and ML.

**Job Summary**
===============

ABOUT FIRST AMERICAN INDIA First American (India) Private Limited (“FAI”) is a Global  
Capability Centre (GCC) of the First American Financial Corporation (FAF: NYSE) a leading provider  
of title insurance, settlement services and risk solutions for real estate transactions since 1889.  
FAI delivers Software Development, IT Infrastructure, Data & Analytics, back-office, and  
knowledge-processing operations to support First American's global operations across the US, UK,  
Australia & Canada. We build technology that powers millions of real-estate transactions, with a  
people-first culture that encourages innovation, collaboration, and solving real-world problems at  
scale.  
Job Title: AWS/Azure Staff Engineer (Remote India)  
About the Role  
You will be the technical lead for First American’s enterprise AWS platform powering application  
modernization, with strong multi-cloud exposure across AWS and Azure. You will define strategy  
and reference architectures with a strong product mindset, lead complex designs (networking,  
security, identity, observability, centralized root account management, and org-wide Config and  
GuardDuty on AWS; Management Groups, Azure Policy and Entra ID RBAC/PIM on Azure), and  
guide multiple squads building a secure, compliant, self-service platform. You will take end-to-end  
ownership, hold yourself accountable for outcomes, communicate clearly across stakeholders,  
mentor engineers, and collaborate with AWS, Azure, and GCP Platform Engineering teams and our  
centralized point of presence to align guardrails and shared patterns across clouds.  
Key Responsibilities  

* Own the end-to-end AWS platform architecture (Organizations/OU model, Control Tower

and AVM account vending, identity, network, security, observability, cost) and its roadmap.  

* Partner with Azure Platform Engineering to align landing-zone design: Azure Management

Groups, subscription vending/Enterprise Scale, identity, network, security, observability,  
and cost governance.  

* Set and enforce platform principles across AWS and Azure: security-by-default, IaC-only

(Terraform with CloudFormation/Bicep/ARM where appropriate), least privilege, and  
defense-in-depth for workloads.  

* Lead AWS hub-and-spoke networking: Direct Connect/Partner connectivity, centralized

DNS, policy-based routes, Palo Alto security inspection, and centralized VPC interface  
endpoints.  

* Align Azure hub-and-spoke networking patterns: ExpressRoute/Partner connectivity, Azure

Virtual WAN, centralized DNS, policy-based routing, Palo Alto inspection, and centralized  
Private Link/Private Endpoints.  

* Define and govern AWS SCPs, IAM policies, and permission boundaries; drive policy-ascode,

exception processes, and AWS Well-Architected reviews.  

* Align Azure governance: Azure Policy, deny assignments, RBAC least-privilege design,

policy-as-code, exception processes, and Azure Well-Architected reviews.
