title: Execution systems-Snr Eng
description:
**Job Summary**

Execute and enhance industrial data historian and execution systems by designing configuring and optimizing AVEVA PI based solutions for global manufacturing and supply chain operations in a hybrid work model. Collaborate with cross functional teams to ensure reliable data acquisition contextualization and analytics that improve efficiency quality and business decision making.

**Responsibilities**

* Design and implement robust AVEVA PI based execution system solutions that reliably collect store and contextualize high volume time series data from diverse plant floor sources to support manufacturing insights and decision making.
* Configure and maintain AVEVA PI interfaces connectors and calculation workflows to ensure accurate data flow from control systems instruments and external applications into the historian environment with minimal downtime.
* Develop advanced PI asset models events and analytics to transform raw operational signals into meaningful metrics that improve visibility of production performance quality trends and equipment health.
* Optimize execution system architectures by reviewing data flows tag configurations and storage strategies to improve system responsiveness scalability and long term maintainability.
* Collaborate with manufacturing and supply chain stakeholders to capture requirements translate process needs into technical specifications and deliver AVEVA PI driven solutions that address real operational challenges.
* Build and refine operational dashboards and self service data views using PI tools so that business users can independently monitor key performance indicators and respond quickly to process deviations.
* Provide expert troubleshooting and root cause analysis for AVEVA PI incidents by examining logs data patterns and configurations then implementing durable corrective actions that strengthen overall system reliability.
* Implement governance practices for tag naming data quality validation and system documentation to maintain consistency and traceability across multiple plants and execution environments.
* Coordinate with cybersecurity and infrastructure teams to align AVEVA PI components with enterprise standards for access control network segmentation and backup to protect critical operational data.
* Guide adoption of data driven practices in manufacturing and supply chain teams by explaining historian capabilities demonstrating use cases and promoting continuous improvement based on trusted data.
* Plan and execute system upgrades patches and migration activities for execution systems so that platforms remain supported secure and aligned with evolving business requirements.
* Estimate effort for enhancements prepare technical design documents and track progress so that execution system deliverables are completed on time and within defined quality expectations.
* Partner with external vendors and internal experts to evaluate new AVEVA PI features complementary tools and integration patterns that can expand the value of existing execution system investments.

**Qualifications**

* Possess a strong background in AVEVA PI Historian with hands on experience in configuration administration and solution development across at least one complex industrial environment.
* Bring eight to twelve years of overall experience in execution systems or related industrial software with a sustained focus on data historian technologies and operational data management.
* Demonstrate practical knowledge of manufacturing or supply chain domains by understanding production workflows material movements and typical plant metrics that benefit from historian insights.
* Apply solid skills in data modeling time series analytics and performance optimization so that historian solutions remain efficient even as tag counts and data volumes grow.
* Use clear communication and documentation abilities to work effectively with process engineers planners and business analysts in a hybrid work setting spanning onsite and remote collaboration.
* Exhibit proficiency in problem solving and incident resolution for complex system interactions involving historians control systems middleware and enterprise applications.
* Show familiarity with integration approaches that connect AVEVA PI with reporting tools analytics platforms or manufacturing execution systems to create end to end digital workflows.
* Display comfort working within structured delivery frameworks and change management practices to ensure safe deployment of modifications in regulated or high criticality operations.

**About Fire & Security Business**

10+ years of wide JCI/Tyco and third-party system knowledge for design, detailed engineering and implementation of Fire Protection and Suppression system. Team provides the services and value-added solutions for the system and provides onsite & remote engineering support across the globe for engineering.

**What you will do**

The primary responsibility for this role is to work on end-to-end presales engineering activities of Fire protection & Suppression opportunities from various verticals (e.g., Transportation, Data Center, Commercial, Industries, Fit-outs, Key Accounts, etc.). You will be handling techno-Commercial activities of the projects covering various such as Fire Sprinkler, Hydrant, water spray, foam and gas suppression Systems etc. You should own the technical consideration to win the job and should be part of HOTO process to get the D&E and OPS approval for booking.

* Initiate the discussion with OEMs & subcontractors and get the right solution and proposal from OEMs.

* Once the deliverables are ready, perform Self QC and get the 2nd level QC done by the Delivery Manager. Eventually, submit the deliverables to the Front Desk.
* Perform 2nd level QC of the deliverables done by other Application Engineers in the team
* Update the SFDC regularly, and complete timesheet & assigned training on time.
* Actively negotiate and follow up with OEMs and Internal OPS/ Post Sales team to get the right kind of prices for the project.
* Regularly participate in the Daily Call /Cadence Call with the business team.

* BE (Mechanical / Electrical)

title: Senior Principal - P&C Platform Engineer
description:
Business Introduction  
GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centred on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems.  
Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines.  
Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges.  
  
**Job Purpose**

Build, automate and run the platform that 50,000+ employees across [X] countries use to communicate and collaborate — Microsoft Teams, SharePoint Online and OneDrive, Exchange Online, the Microsoft 365 apps, Power Platform and Microsoft 365 Copilot.

This is the hands-on build role. The Platform Engineer takes architecture direction and a prioritised backlog and turns them into working, tested, automated, documented configuration in production. The expectation is engineering rather than administration: configuration expressed as code and deployed through pipelines, not clicked through a portal and remembered by whoever was on shift.

The role also runs what it builds. Platform Engineers own the operational health of their workloads — diagnosing the awkward, intermittent, only-happens-in-Tokyo problems that never reproduce in a lab, and eliminating the root cause rather than closing the ticket.

**Key Responsibilities**

  
* Design, build, test and deploy configuration across the Microsoft 365 estate: Teams policies, SharePoint and OneDrive settings, Exchange Online transport and mail flow, Purview policies, Entra ID groups and Conditional Access as it applies to collaboration workloads.
* Implement to the reference architecture and standards set by the Principal Architect; raise a design challenge when reality does not match the design rather than quietly deviating.
* Deliver backlog items from sprint to production with the tests, telemetry, documentation and rollback path included — "done" means running and observable, not merely configured.
* Build and maintain integrations using Microsoft Graph and platform APIs; write the connective tissue between M365, ServiceNow, HR systems and the wider application estate.
* Automate everything that would otherwise be done twice. Provisioning, lifecycle, reporting, remediation, joiner/mover/leaver flows, licence assignment and reclamation.
* Express tenant configuration as code in version control; build and maintain CI/CD pipelines for policy and solution deployment with automated validation and staged ring-based rollout.
* Replace manual runbook steps with self-healing and self-service; treat a recurring manual task as a defect with a backlog item attached.
* Own operational health of assigned workloads: monitoring, alerting, capacity, service health response and performance.
* Investigate and resolve complex incidents and problems — third-line escalation for collaboration platform issues — and drive permanent root-cause elimination.
* Participate in an on-call rotation for major incidents affecting the collaboration platform.
* Manage the continuous change stream from Microsoft: assess message centre and roadmap items, test in a lab tenant, and implement, defer or disable with the reasoning recorded.
* Maintain patch, currency and configuration compliance; remediate vulnerabilities and drift.
* Implement and maintain security and information governance controls in the collaboration estate: sensitivity labels, DLP, retention, external sharing controls, app consent and Conditional Access.
* Produce the evidence that audits require — configuration baselines, change records, access reviews — generated automatically wherever possible.
* Build to regulated-environment requirements where applicable, including GxP-validated systems and the qualification and change control they demand.
* Work daily with the Product Owner on refinement and estimation, and with the Architect on design; give honest estimates and flag risk early.
* Produce operational documentation, runbooks and knowledge articles good enough that the service desk can use them and the next engineer can pick the work up.
* Support and coach the service desk and second-line teams; reduce escalation volume by transferring capability, not by absorbing it.
* Mentor junior engineers and contribute to engineering standards and code review within the squad.

**Education & Professional Qualifications**

  

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related discipline, or equivalent demonstrable professional experience. Strong practical experience is an acceptable substitute for formal qualification.
* Relevant certifications desirable (e.g., Microsoft 365 Certified: Administrator Expert, Teams Administrator Associate, Identity and Access Administrator Associate, Information Protection and Compliance Administrator, Power Platform Solution Architect, Azure Administrator, ITIL v4 Foundation).

**Area of Specialisation**

* Hands-on Microsoft 365 platform engineering across the core collaboration workloads — Exchange Online, SharePoint Online / OneDrive and Microsoft Teams — at 50,000-user scale.
* Configuration-as-code for tenant settings — Git, CI/CD pipelines, automated validation and staged ring-based rollout — plus advanced PowerShell and Microsoft Graph automation.
* Microsoft Purview implementation — sensitivity labels, DLP, retention — and the practical behaviour of external sharing, Conditional Access and app consent controls once real users meet them.
* Complex collaboration-platform troubleshooting across client, identity, network and service layers, with root-cause elimination rather than ticket closure.

**Experience Required**

* 15Years overall and 10+ years in IT engineering or platform operations, including 5+ years working hands-on with Microsoft 365 in a production enterprise environment.
* Experience supporting or engineering a tenant of 5,000+ users; comfortable with the difference between a small tenant and a large one.
* Demonstrable hands-on capability across at least two of Exchange Online, SharePoint Online/OneDrive, or Microsoft Teams — at a level that includes troubleshooting, not only configuration.
* Working PowerShell proficiency with real examples of automation delivered into production, plus practical experience calling the Microsoft Graph API.
* Familiarity with Git and pull-request-based working; willingness to work configuration-as-code if not already doing so.
* Experience operating in an ITIL-aligned change and incident process, including production change ownership.
* Experience delivering within a Scrum or Kanban squad, including refinement, estimation and sprint commitment.
* Willingness to participate in an on-call rotation for major incidents.
* Fluent English, written and spoken; able to explain a technical issue to a non-technical colleague.

**Desirable:**

* Experience in a regulated industry — pharmaceutical, life sciences, biotech, financial services or healthcare — including GxP/CSV/CSA and validated-system change control.
* Migration delivery at scale — on-premises Exchange or SharePoint to cloud, file share to OneDrive/SharePoint, tenant-to-tenant, or third-party platform (Slack, Zoom, Google Workspace, Box) consolidation.
* Teams Phone / voice — Direct Routing, Operator Connect, PSTN migration.
* Teams Rooms and collaboration hardware — deployment, configuration and remote management at estate scale.
* Viva suite implementation — Connections, Engage, Learning, Insights.
* Power Platform development — Power Automate flows, Power Apps, Dataverse, Copilot Studio agents.
* A second language beyond PowerShell — Python, C# or Go — and experience building small services or Azure Functions.
* Infrastructure-as-code tooling — Bicep, ARM or Terraform for the Azure resources supporting the platform.
* Endpoint management adjacency — Intune, device compliance and the endpoint's role in Conditional Access.
* Security engineering exposure — Defender for Office 365, Defender for Cloud Apps, threat hunting in M365 audit data.
* Accessibility testing and remediation in collaboration tooling.

**Skills/Background**

  

* Deep hands-on configuration and troubleshooting across the core M365 workloads — Exchange Online (mail flow, transport rules, hybrid, anti-spam), SharePoint Online and OneDrive (site and permission models, sharing controls, migration), and Microsoft Teams (policies, lifecycle, meetings, channels).
* Entra ID as it applies to collaboration — groups and dynamic membership, Conditional Access, app registrations and consent, service principals and app-only authentication.
* Microsoft Purview implementation — sensitivity labels, DLP policies, retention and disposition — and the practical behaviour of each once real users meet it.
* Microsoft 365 apps deployment and configuration — servicing channels, policy management via the Cloud Policy service, add-in management.
* Power Platform administration — environments, DLP connector policies, solution deployment and ALM.
* Microsoft 365 Copilot implementation mechanics — licence assignment, permission and oversharing remediation, and grounding behaviour.
* Advanced PowerShell — modules, error handling, parameterisation, idempotency; scripts written to be maintained by someone else, not just to run once.
* Microsoft Graph API fluency — REST, delta queries, permission scopes, app-only auth, throttling and retry handling.
* Monitoring and diagnostics — Log Analytics and KQL, M365 usage and audit telemetry, Power BI reporting; instrumenting your own work so problems surface before users report them.
* Complex troubleshooting — methodical isolation of intermittent, multi-layer problems spanning client, identity, network and service.
* ITIL-aligned practice — incident, problem and change management executed properly at enterprise scale, including credible change records and rollback plans.
* Production discipline — testing in a lab tenant first, ring-based release, blast-radius awareness, and the habit of asking "what does this do to 50,000 people" before pressing apply.
* Clear technical writing — runbooks, knowledge articles and design notes others can actually follow.
* Ownership — sees an item through to working in production and stays with it when it misbehaves afterwards.
* Curiosity and self-direction — reads release notes, tests in a lab, and brings improvement ideas to refinement unprompted.
* Collaboration — works well with product, architecture, security and the service desk; explains technical constraint without condescension.
* User empathy — remembers that a policy setting is somebody's Monday morning.

**Skills**

Access Control (AC), Agile Methodology, Cisco Routing, Cross-Functional Teamwork, Data Analysis, Design Thinking, DevOps, Microsoft Dynamics 365 Data Migration Testing, Microsoft Office 365, Operator Interfaces, Prioritization, Product Development Research, Product Roadmapping, Project Management, Return on Investment (ROI), Software Development, Strategy Deployment, User Experience (UX), User Interface (UI) Design

**Why GSK?**

**Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.**

GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale.

People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we’re committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people.

**Inclusion at GSK:**

As an employer committed to Inclusion, we encourage you to reach out if you need any adjustments during the recruitment process.

Please contact our Recruitment Team at IN.recruitment-adjustments@gsk.com to discuss your needs.

**Important notice to Employment businesses/ Agencies**

GSK does not accept referrals from employment businesses and/or employment agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site. All employment businesses/agencies are required to contact GSK's commercial and general procurement/human resources department to obtain prior written authorization before referring any candidates to GSK. The obtaining of prior written authorization is a condition precedent to any agreement (verbal or written) between the employment business/ agency and GSK. In the absence of such written authorization being obtained any actions undertaken by the employment business/agency shall be deemed to have been performed without the consent or contractual agreement of GSK. GSK shall therefore not be liable for any fees arising from such actions or any fees arising from any referrals by employment businesses/agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site.

It has come to our attention that the names of GlaxoSmithKline or GSK or our group companies are being used in connection with bogus job advertisements or through unsolicited emails asking candidates to make some payments for recruitment opportunities and interview. Please be advised that such advertisements and emails are not connected with the GlaxoSmithKline group in any way.

**GlaxoSmithKline does not charge any fee whatsoever for recruitment process. Please do not make payments to any individuals / entities in connection with recruitment with any GlaxoSmithKline (or GSK) group company at any worldwide location. Even if they claim that the money is refundable.**

If you come across unsolicited email from email addresses not ending in gsk.com or job advertisements which state that you should contact an email address that does not end in “gsk.com”, you should disregard the same and inform us by emailing askus@gsk.com, so that we can confirm to you if the job is genuine.

title: Vulnerability Management Engineer I
description:
**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Validate vulnerability scan schedules and confirm scans are running as planned across assigned networks, subnets, and regions.
* Monitor scanner appliance health, scanner assignment, scan configuration, and scan failures, including offline scanners, authentication issues, access issues, and network connectivity problems.
* Raise, update, and follow up on incident or remediation tickets related to scanner failures, scan issues, and vulnerability remediation activities.
* Support approved ad hoc rescans for eligible assets, validate hostname, IP address, vulnerability details, and confirm whether remediation has successfully resolved the finding.
* Update remediation tickets with scan results, CSV reports, evidence, and clear remediation validation notes.
* Monitor vulnerability dashboards and extract reports from tools such as ArmorCode and CrowdStrike for findings, statistics, SLA tracking, and evidence collection.
* Review exception requests, validate affected assets, justification, evidence, asset owner, risk owner, exception category, and approval status.
* Support creation and maintenance of approved exceptions in vulnerability management platforms after required approvals are completed.
* Assist in handling vulnerability advisories by validating CVE availability, affected assets, impacted versions, and coordinating remediation follow-up with asset owners.
* Review finding reassignment requests, validate ownership evidence, prepare templates, and coordinate with internal stakeholders for reassignment review.
* Assist with External Attack Surface Management findings by identifying asset ownership, coordinating remediation, and supporting owner mapping activities.
* Support immediate follow-up for critical vulnerabilities that may impact external security ratings or business risk indicators.

**Progressive Security Engineering Responsibilities**
-----------------------------------------------------

As the engineer gains experience and demonstrates operational maturity, they may gradually support selected security engineering activities under guidance. These may include security configuration assessment support, validation of asset onboarding requirements, review of approved security templates, coordination with engineering teams for tooling issues, and contribution to process improvement or automation initiatives.

**Required Skills and Knowledge**
---------------------------------

* Basic understanding of cybersecurity concepts, vulnerabilities, risk ratings, CVEs, remediation, and patching.
* Foundational knowledge of networking concepts such as IP addresses, subnets, ports, protocols, and network connectivity.
* Basic familiarity with Windows, Linux, network devices, databases, and cloud or virtualized environments.
* Ability to work with dashboards, reports, CSV exports, tickets, and documented operational procedures.
* Good written communication skills for ticket updates, stakeholder follow-ups, and evidence documentation.
* Attention to detail and ability to validate asset information, vulnerability details, scan results, and exception evidence accurately.
* Willingness to learn vulnerability management platforms, IT service management tools, CMDB processes, and enterprise security workflows.

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science/information technology/Cybersecurity/Electronics or a related field.
* Cybersecurity fundamentals training or certifications such as Security+, CC, Network+, or equivalent learning exposure are preferred but not mandatory.

**Behavioral Expectations**
---------------------------

* Demonstrate ownership of assigned tasks and follow through until closure.
* Communicate clearly with internal teams, asset owners, and requestors.
* Follow documented procedures and escalate issues when required.
* Maintain accuracy in reporting, ticket updates, and evidence handling.
* Show curiosity, willingness to learn, and readiness to grow into broader security engineering responsibilities.
* Work effectively in a remote environment with regular updates, collaboration, and disciplined time management.

The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. They are not intended to be construed as an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties, and skills.

title: Senior Solutions Architect – AI Infrastructure Networking (remote in India)
description:
**Company Description**

**About Mirantis**

Mirantis, an IREN company, is the Kubernetes-native AI infrastructure company, enabling organizations to build and operate scalable, secure, and sovereign infrastructure for modern AI, machine learning, and data-intensive applications. By combining open source innovation with deep expertise in Kubernetes orchestration, Mirantis empowers platform engineering teams to deliver composable, production-ready developer platforms across any environment—on-premises, in the cloud, at the edge, or in sovereign data centers. As enterprises navigate the growing complexity of AI-driven workloads, Mirantis delivers the automation, GPU orchestration, and policy-driven control needed to manage infrastructure with confidence and agility. Committed to open standards and freedom from lock-in, Mirantis ensures that customers retain full control of their infrastructure strategy. https://www.mirantis.com/

 **Job Description**

About the role

We are seeking a Senior Solutions Architect with deep networking expertise to join the Voyager team in the Mirantis Office of the CTO. You will own the network solutioning of k0rdent AI, our platform for building and operating GPU clouds and AI factories, from metal to model.

You will design how large GPU clusters are interconnected, how tenants are isolated, and how workloads reach the network from containers, virtual machines and bare metal nodes. You will turn that design into published reference architectures, working code and proofs of concept that run on real hardware with our customers and partners.

As part of the Office of the CTO, research is a core part of the job. You will explore designs and technologies before customers ask for them, prototype ideas that may not ship, and challenge established practice when a better approach exists. Your work will shape where k0rdent AI goes next, not only how it is deployed today.

This role combines research with hands-on, outward-facing work. You will split your time between exploring new designs, writing architecture, building and validating it in the lab, and explaining it to engineers, executives and conference audiences. You will work with Solutions Architects, Partner Management and Engineering colleagues across many countries and time zones.

Key Responsibilities

Reference architecture

* Design and publish network reference architectures and solution designs for k0rdent AI, covering data center topologies from a single rack to multi-thousand-GPU clusters.
* Define compute (east-west) fabrics on InfiniBand and on RoCEv2 Ethernet, including rail-optimised and fat-tree / Clos designs, oversubscription and failure-domain choices.
* Define front-end, storage and management networks, and how they connect to customer data centers, public clouds and hybrid environments.
* Specify multi-tenant isolation across the stack: InfiniBand partitions (PKeys), VRFs and EVPN-VXLAN on Ethernet, and Kubernetes-level network policy.
* Document scale limits and trade-offs (cost, performance, operability, vendor lock-in) with defensible reasoning a customer can follow.

Host and platform networking

* Define how Linux hosts expose NICs, DPUs and SuperNICs to workloads: PCI passthrough, SR-IOV virtual functions, IOMMU groups, NUMA and GPU-NIC affinity.
* Design Kubernetes networking for AI workloads: primary and secondary CNIs, Multus, SR-IOV and RDMA device plugins, NVIDIA Network Operator, and Dynamic Resource Allocation (DRA).
* Design networking for virtual machines on KubeVirt, including passthrough and SR-IOV for GPU and RDMA traffic.

Research and exploration

* Track and evaluate emerging technologies and standards in AI networking, such as Ultra Ethernet (UEC), SuperNIC and DPU offloads, scale-up and scale-across fabrics, and Kubernetes DRA network drivers.
* Prototype alternative designs in the lab, including ones customers have not yet asked for, and measure them against current practice.
* Challenge established or customer-preferred designs when evidence points to a better option, and make the case with data.
* Publish findings as internal research notes and design proposals and, where appropriate, as external papers, blog posts or talks.

Code and proofs of concept

* Build and run proofs of concept with customers and partners, on Mirantis lab hardware and on customer sites, and report results against agreed success criteria.
* Write automation and tooling (Python, Go, Bash, Ansible, Helm, Kubernetes manifests, Terraform) that makes the reference architectures reproducible.
* Run validation and benchmarking of fabrics and host configurations (e.g. NCCL tests, perftest, ib\_write\_bw) and turn findings into design guidance.

Customers, partners and community

* Act as the network subject matter expert in customer discovery, design reviews and architecture workshops, bringing thought leadership and new ideas rather than only reflecting current practice.
* Work with hardware and networking partners (e.g. NVIDIA, server OEMs, switch and network vendors) on joint designs and validations.
* Innovate and feed research results back to Product and Engineering, and help shape the k0rdent AI roadmap.
* Present at industry events, webinars and partner summits, and run hands-on workshops for technical audiences.
* Write technical content: reference architecture documents, solution briefs, blog posts and internal enablement.

 **Qualifications**

Education and experience

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Telecommunications or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 8+ years in network engineering or network architecture, with at least 3 years in data center, HPC or cloud infrastructure networking.
* Customer-facing experience as a solutions architect, pre-sales engineer, consultant or technical lead.

Required technical skills

* Data center network design: spine-leaf and Clos topologies, rail-optimised GPU fabrics, oversubscription, ECMP, and the operational challenges of scaling to thousands of nodes.
* InfiniBand: subnet management, partitioning, adaptive routing, and how NCCL / RDMA traffic behaves on the fabric.
* RoCEv2 on Ethernet: lossless and congestion-controlled designs (PFC, ECN, DCQCN), QoS, MTU and buffer tuning.
* Routing and overlays: BGP, EVPN-VXLAN, VRFs and their use for multi-tenancy.
* Hybrid and multi-cloud connectivity: interconnects, VPN, cloud provider networking constructs, and IP address and DNS planning across sites.
* Linux networking: how the kernel and drivers manage NICs, PCI passthrough, SR-IOV, IOMMU, NUMA affinity, and tools such as iproute2, ethtool and devlink.
* Kubernetes networking: CNI plugins (e.g. Cilium, Calico, OVN-Kubernetes), Multus and secondary networks, SR-IOV and RDMA device plugins, network policy and service exposure.
* Virtualisation on Kubernetes: KubeVirt, and how VM networking, passthrough and SR-IOV are configured there.
* Programming or scripting in at least one language (Python or Go preferred), and comfortable using Git, CI and infrastructure-as-code.

How you work

We hire for these behaviours as much as for technical depth, and will ask for concrete examples of each.

* Curious. You dig into why a fabric behaves the way it does, read the specs and the source, and keep up with how AI networking is changing. You question established designs, including the ones customers are used to, when there is a better way.
* Ownership. You take a reference architecture or a POC from the first sketch to a published, validated result, and you stand behind it.
* Proactive. You spot gaps in the product, the documentation or a customer design before you are asked, and you act on them.
* Fast learner. You get productive quickly in unfamiliar hardware, software or customer environments.
* Business acumen. You connect network design choices to cost, time-to-value and risk, and explain them in those terms to decision makers.

Communication and collaboration

* Excellent written and spoken English; you write documents others can build from.
* Comfortable presenting to large audiences at conferences and events, and running hands-on workshops.
* Able to adapt the message to the audience, from network engineers to customer executives.
* Experience working in an international, distributed company, across time zones and different work cultures, with Solutions Architects, Partner Management and Engineering teams.

Nice to have

* Hands-on experience with NVIDIA networking: Quantum InfiniBand, Spectrum-X Ethernet, ConnectX SuperNICs, BlueField DPUs, UFM, and NVIDIA reference designs for AI factories.
* Experience with GPU cloud, neocloud or HPC operators, or with NVIDIA Cloud Partner (NCP) style deployments.
* Bare-metal provisioning and lifecycle: Metal3, Ironic, Redfish, PXE / iPXE, and Cluster API.
* Network automation and SDN controllers, and switch operating systems such as Cumulus Linux, SONiC or vendor equivalents.
* Global load balancing and service exposure for distributed inference (GSLB, Gateway API, ingress).
* Familiarity with Software-Defined Storage networking for AI (NVMe-oF, GPUDirect Storage).
* Experience with Mirantis products, MKE, k0s, k0rdent networking.
* Contributions to open-source networking or Kubernetes projects, or a track record of public talks and technical writing.
* Participation in standards or industry bodies (e.g. Ultra Ethernet Consortium, OCP, IETF), or published research, patents or white papers.
* Additional languages beyond English, for example a European language.

Location, travel and working model

This role is remote, open to candidates based in Europe.

* You will work with a team spread across many time zones; some meetings will fall outside standard local hours.
* Travel of up to 25% for customer engagements, partner meetings, lab work and industry events, primarily within the EU and US.
* Mirantis is an equal opportunity employer. Compensation and benefits are set according to the local market and employment arrangement.

 **Additional Information**

**Why you’ll love Mirantis**

* Build the observability foundation for the AI cloud era, working directly with leading GPU cloud operators, NeoClouds, sovereign clouds, and AI-first enterprises
* Collaborate with a world-class, distributed team committed to openness and technical excellence
* Shape the product narrative and influence go-to-market success

description:
**Date posted** 10/15/2026

### **Category** **Engineering****Hire Type** **Employee****Job ID** **19243****Remote Eligible** **No****Date Posted** **10/15/2026**

### **We Are** Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI-powered products. We deliver industry-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow.

### **You Are**

You have spent over a decade designing analog circuits that have to move data at speeds most engineers never touch, and you know that the difference between a SERDES that works in simulation and one that works in silicon is a hundred small decisions about layout, process variation, and timing handoff. You are the kind of engineer who reads a SerDes standard and immediately starts sketching architectures that push beyond what the spec requires because you see where the bottleneck will be two years from now.

You do not wait for someone to tell you the PLL is the problem. You run the jitter budget, trace it back to the oscillator, and propose three solutions before the next design review. Taped-out circuits in FinFET nodes where a few femtofarads of parasitic capacitance can kill your bandwidth have taught you to work with layout engineers who understand that your redline is not optional.

Presenting simulation data to a customer review panel and explaining why your adaptive equalizer architecture will handle their worst-case channel without adding another milliwatt is something you do comfortably. Mentoring matters to you, not because it looks good on a review, but because you remember the senior engineer who taught you how to read an eye diagram and you want to be that person for someone else.

At Synopsys, you will work on Multi-Gbps SERDES IP that goes into chips that power data centers, automotive networks, and AI accelerators. The problems are hard, the process nodes are cutting-edge, and what you design will ship.

### **What You'll Be Doing**

* Review high-speed SerDes standards (PCIe, Ethernet, USB, CXL) and translate them into transceiver architectures and detailed sub-block specifications for Multi-Gbps NRZ and PAM4 designs
* Architect and design analog/mixed-signal circuits including TX drivers, RX front-ends, adaptive equalizers, PLLs, DLLs, bandgap references, regulators, oscillators, and ADC/DAC blocks for advanced FinFET and gate-all-around process nodes
* Collaborate with digital design teams on analog/digital co-design, calibration loops, adaptation algorithms, and timing handoff to ensure seamless integration and optimal performance
* Work directly with layout engineers to guide physical implementation, minimize parasitics, manage device stress and process variation, and ensure robust post-silicon performance
* Present simulation results, design trade-offs, and architectural decisions in internal reviews, customer meetings, and industry panel discussions
* Document design features, simulation methodologies, test plans, and characterization results, and support post-silicon bring-up and debug with electrical analysis and design iteration proposals
* Analyze customer silicon data and field performance to identify improvement opportunities and drive post-silicon design updates for next-generation IP releases

### **The Impact You Will Have**

* Define the architectural direction for Synopsys SERDES IP, influencing product roadmaps and enabling next-generation connectivity standards across automotive, data center, and AI markets
* Deliver power, performance, and area improvements that directly affect the competitiveness of Synopsys IP in advanced process nodes and high-speed communication applications
* Solve post-silicon challenges that unblock customer tape-outs and ensure successful deployment of Synopsys IP in high-volume production chips
* Mentor analog designers across the team, raising the technical bar for circuit design, simulation methodology, and design-for-reliability practices
* Strengthen Synopsys leadership in Multi-Gbps SERDES by contributing to industry standards bodies, customer engagements, and technical publications
* Enable faster time-to-market for customers by streamlining design and verification flows and reducing silicon respins through robust pre-silicon validation
* Shape the future of high-speed analog design at Synopsys by driving innovation in adaptive equalization, low-power PLLs, and signal integrity for next-generation process technologies

### **What You'll Need**

* MTech/MS with 8+ years or BTech/BS with 10+ years of hands-on analog IC design experience in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field
* Proven track record of CMOS tape-outs in FinFET technologies with demonstrable experience in Multi-Gbps high-speed designs using NRZ and PAM4 modulation
* Deep expertise in SERDES sub-circuit design including TX drivers, RX front-ends, adaptive equalizers, PLLs, DLLs, bandgap references, regulators, oscillators, and data converters
* Strong understanding of analog/digital co-design, calibration and adaptation algorithms, and timing handoff between analog and digital domains
* Proficiency with schematic entry, physical layout collaboration, design verification tools, and SPICE simulators (Spectre, HSPICE, or similar)
* Experience with scripting languages such as TCL, PERL, or MATLAB for post-processing simulation data and automating design tasks
* Solid grounding in system-level budgeting for jitter, amplitude, and noise, and familiarity with signal integrity challenges including packaging parasitics, crosstalk, and channel loss. Experience with ESD protection, custom digital design, and design-for-reliability considerations (electromigration, IR drop, aging, self-heating) is a plus. Prior experience with high-speed interleaved SAR ADCs is a strong plus.

### **Who You Are**

* You can walk into a design review, look at a jitter waterfall plot, and pinpoint the architectural bottleneck in under five minutes without needing a slide deck
* You push back when a specification does not make sense or when a layout decision will compromise performance, and you do it with data and a proposed alternative
* You are the engineer others come to when a circuit is not behaving and simulation does not match silicon, because you know how to debug across domains and find the real root cause
* You write clear, thorough documentation because you know that six months from now, someone else will need to understand your design choices and you want them to succeed
* You stay current with emerging process technologies, circuit techniques, and industry standards because you know that what works in 7nm will not necessarily work in 3nm
* You value collaboration and knowledge-sharing, and you take the time to explain a complex trade-off to a junior engineer or a non-technical stakeholder without losing the nuance

**Design least privilege and blast-radius containment.** Establish the lowest practical access boundary, preventing access to adjacent business-unit data and storage.

**Control privileged access and configuration drift.** Govern privileged elevation and break-glass access, and detect unauthorized changes with monitored alert latency and remediation.

**Protect data and secrets.** Establish controls for encryption, secrets management, and network security aligned to relevant regulatory compliance requirements.

**Build guardrails and auditability.** Set up security guardrails, auditability, and access governance so the platform stays compliant and controllable as it scales.

**Provide cross-account technical leadership.** Act as a go-to security reviewer across multiple accounts, contributing to design reviews and resolving access and governance issues that individual delivery teams cannot.

Regulated-industry experience (financial services, healthcare, or similar).

**Job Description**

System Engineer – AS400 is responsible for the day-to-day administration, availability and performance of THE CLIENT's IBM i (AS400) platform, which hosts business-critical JD Edwards and Lawson workloads. The role covers operating system and DB2 administration, LPAR management, and the supporting Brocade SAN fabric.

This position is being established in India as a designated back-up to the single AS400 resource THE CLIENT retains in the United States, providing continuity of coverage for the platform through its remaining lifecycle.

* Management of the AS400 operating system and DB2 database environment.
* Support and administration of three production instances of JD Edwards running on AS400.
* Support and administration of multiple JD Edwards development environments.
* Management of LPARs (logical partitions) across the IBM Power estate.
* Management of the Brocade switches and SAN fabric supporting the AS400 stack.
* Support and administration of the Lawson application, which is also hosted on AS400.
* Act as back-up to the US-based AS400 resource, ensuring continuity of platform coverage.

The successful candidate will operate within the following THE CLIENT infrastructure landscape:

* **Compute & virtualisation:** VMware vCenter, Nutanix, hyperconverged compute (Dell VxRail), Dell PowerEdge, IBM Power / IBM i (LPARs). Total server estate of approximately 371 servers.
* **Storage & backup:** IBM storage array, Amazon S3 / Wasabi, Veeam, IBM SAN fabric (Brocade on the AS400 stack), and KeepIt for Microsoft 365 backup.
* **Database:** Microsoft SQL Server and AS400 DB2, including one production MS SQL Always On cluster across three nodes, generating approximately 10 incidents per month.
* **Cloud:** AWS (Redshift) and Azure (Azure SQL Server).
* **Service management:** ServiceNow Zurich release, with limited CMDB and CI maturity at present.
* **Documentation:** Knowledge management and standard operating procedures are currently very limited on the infrastructure side.

**Engagement Context & Platform Roadmap**
-----------------------------------------

Candidates should be aware that the AS400 platform is on a defined decommissioning path:

* THE CLIENT retains one AS400 resource in the US and has requested a back-up resource be hired in India — this role.
* By end of 2027, two of the three JD Edwards instances will be migrated to Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) and managed by Oracle.
* The remaining instance is the Protein instance, located in Alabama.
* Lawson will be migrated to Microsoft Dynamics.

Given the limited existing knowledge management and SOP coverage on the infrastructure side, a meaningful part of this role will involve documenting the environment to support a clean transition and eventual decommissioning.

* Good years of hands-on experience administering IBM i / AS400 environments in a production setting.
* Strong working knowledge of IBM i operating system administration and DB2 for i, including performance tuning, journaling and backup/recovery.
* Demonstrated experience with LPAR creation, configuration and management on IBM Power hardware (Power 9 or comparable).
* Practical experience administering SAN fabric and Brocade switches, including zoning.

title: Engineer - Inverter Controls
description:
The Engineering Services Team operates globally, providing remote support to field services personnel to uphold top-tier performance for GE's Solar and Storage Solutions assets. This entails optimizing the value of post-COD aspects such as warranties, long-term service agreements (LTSA), and Change-Modification-Upgrades (CMUs) to uphold customer satisfaction.

**Job Description**
===================

**About the Position**

The Controls Engineer sits within the **Reliability and Root Cause Analysis (RCA) team**, with a primary focus on **inverter controls** troubleshooting and a growing emphasis on **BESS (Battery Energy Storage System)** unit and plant control support as new BESS sites come online. This role drives excellence in the functionality, reliability, and efficiency of inverters and BESS systems, integrating them effectively with other systems and aligning with both industry standards and GE's operational objectives. In addition to troubleshooting inverter and BESS-related issues, the engineer actively participates in Root Cause Analyses (RCAs) — often working through issue tickets and bug fixes as first-line troubleshooting — and contributes to Change-Modification-Upgrades (CMUs) aimed at enhancing system performance and functionality.

**Roles and Responsibilities**

* Ensure optimal performance and reliability of inverters and BESS units in the field.
* Troubleshoot and resolve escalated inverter and BESS controls-related issues, including tickets and bug fixes.
* Participate in Root Cause Analysis (RCA) investigations related to inverter and BESS controls issues.
* Support triage and resolution of control system issues as first-line troubleshooting, distinct from formal RCA processes.
* Provide input and development support for **custom control behavior requests** driven by customer-specific requirements.
* Support BESS/unit control troubleshooting in addition to core inverter controls responsibilities.
* Collaborate with the Center of Excellence (COE) and NPI (New Product Introduction) teams on legacy system programming changes as needed.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate inverters and BESS systems effectively with other plant systems.
* Lead or support projects focused on inverter/BESS system upgrades and enhancements.
* Provide expert guidance on inverter and BESS technology selection and implementation.
* Stay updated with the latest inverter and BESS technologies and industry trends.
* Develop and maintain detailed technical documentation and guides for inverter/BESS operations.
* Support on-site start-up and integration of inverter and BESS systems.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor's in Electrical Engineering or a related field.
* Minimum of 2 years of relevant experience with inverter controls systems.
* Experience with developing or maintaining inverter control systems and associated software.
* Working knowledge of BESS (Battery Energy Storage System) controls.
* Ability to communicate fluently in English (written and spoken).

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Master's degree in Electrical Engineering or a related field.
* Basic networking knowledge relevant to control system troubleshooting (e.g., BESS communication networks).
* Experience distinguishing hardware vs. software root causes in inverter systems (e.g., power supplies, phase modules).
* Exposure to custom/non-standard control software development.
* Familiarity with legacy inverter/BESS control systems and upgrade processes.
* Strong knowledge of modern inverter and BESS technologies and associated systems.
* Design and development knowledge in renewables applications.
* Demonstrated experience in inverter/BESS system integration and optimization.
* Strong interpersonal skills for effective stakeholder communication.
* Previous experience with GE P80i and PERTU systems.
* Ability to collaborate with cross-functional teams.
* Familiarity with renewable energy regulations and standards.

**Required Characteristics**

* Self-motivated.
* Performance-driven.
* Excellent interpersonal and communication skills.
* Proactive and dynamic approach.
* Solution and customer-oriented mindset.
* Execution-driven with a focus on achieving results.
* Comfortable operating at the intersection of hardware and software troubleshooting.

**Additional Information**
==========================

**Relocation Assistance Provided:** Yes

title: Senior Security Specialist
description:
**Role Summary**

The Cybersecurity Architecture Reviewer is responsible for conducting security architecture assessments for applications, platforms, cloud services, infrastructure, and technology solutions to ensure alignment with enterprise security policies, architectural standards, and industry best practices. The role includes reviewing firewall connectivity requests, network security designs, and application integrations to identify risks and recommend secure solutions while enabling business delivery.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Conduct cybersecurity architecture reviews for new and existing applications, platforms, cloud services, and technology solutions.

* Review cloud, on-premises, hybrid, and third-party integrations to ensure secure architectural design and connectivity patterns.

* Assess solution designs, architecture diagrams, data flows, technical documentation, and technical requirements from a security perspective.

* Review firewall and network access requests to validate compliance with approved architectures, security standards, and business requirements.

* Evaluate security controls, including authentication, authorization, encryption, logging, monitoring, and data protection mechanisms.

* Partner with Solution Architects, Engineering Teams, and Project Teams to embed security requirements into solution designs and development initiatives.

* Perform firewall policy reviews across traditional, next-generation, and virtualized firewall platforms.

* Design, implement, and support firewall governance processes, including rule recertification, change management, audit traceability, and exception management.

* Design and assess secure connectivity patterns aligned with enterprise security principles, architectural standards, and regulatory requirements.

* Provide security recommendations, architectural guidance, and risk mitigation strategies based on industry best practices and organizational standards.

* Support governance activities, including periodic access reviews, firewall rule recertification, security exception reviews, and compliance assessments.

* Operate and maintain metrics, dashboards, and reporting to measure the effectiveness and efficiency of the Security Architecture function.

* Document security findings, risks, recommendations, and review outcomes, ensuring effective stakeholder communication and remediation tracking.

* Evangelise Security Architecture as an enabler as opposed to a blocking point



**Required Skills & Experience**

* Strong understanding of cybersecurity architecture principles and secure solution design practices.
* Experience reviewing cloud environments (AWS, Azure, GCP), on-premises infrastructures, and hybrid architectures.
* Knowledge of network security technologies, including firewalls, proxies, VPNs, network segmentation, and secure remote access solutions.
* Experience with firewall platforms such as Palo Alto, Check Point, Fortinet, Cisco FMC/FTD, VMware NSX, or equivalent technologies.
* Strong understanding of authentication protocols, Identity and Access Management (IAM), encryption technologies, PKI, and key management.
* Experience conducting threat modelling, risk assessments, and security architecture reviews.
* Understanding of API security, SaaS security, vendor risk management, and third-party connectivity assessments.
* Familiarity with security frameworks and standards such as NIST CSF, ISO 27001, CIS Controls, OWASP, and Zero Trust Architecture.
* Strong analytical, stakeholder management, communication, and influencing skills.
* Ability to translate technical risks into business-focused recommendations.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Industry certifications such as CISSP, CCSP, SABSA, TOGAF, CCSK, AWS Security Specialty, Azure Security Engineer, or equivalent.
* Experience working in highly regulated industries, including Financial Services, Capital Markets, Banking, Insurance, or Critical Infrastructure sectors.
* Hands-on experience with security architecture governance, firewall review processes /FW operations and compliance activities.
* Experience operating security review processes, risk management frameworks, and enterprise security governance programs.

**Experience Level**

Typically 7-14+ years of cybersecurity experience, with at least 5 years in Security Architecture, Security Review, or Network Security Governance roles

title: Lead DevSecops Engineer
description:
**Summary of This Role**

Combines software development and IT operations practices which shorten the systems delivery life cycle and provide a continuous delivery platform and complements the efficiencies of Agile software development methods. Builds and maintains the tooling and infrastructure used to automate the release, deployment, and upgrade processes. Ensures continuous, high velocity delivery and automated deployment through the use of software provisioning, configuration management, source code management and/or team collaboration applications.

* Architect and implement automated build, test, and deployment workflows using tools like Harness.io and GitHub Actions.

* Develop and maintain infrastructure-as-code (IaC) pipelines using Terraform.
* Ensure consistent provisioning and configuration of cloud resources (compute, networking, storage, IAM).

* Monitor cost, performance, and security posture; recommend and implement improvements.

* Build reusable pipeline templates and shared libraries to accelerate delivery across teams.
* Integrate testing frameworks (unit, integration, security) and observability tools (logging, metrics, tracing) into workflows.
* Diagnose and resolve pipeline failures, infrastructure provisioning errors, or environment drift.
* Monitor and triage security vulnerabilities identified by platforms such as Wiz and Macroscope; partner with engineering and security stakeholders to drive remediation efforts.
* Collaborate with security teams to integrate automated vulnerability detection and reporting into CI/CD pipelines.
* Configure and maintain secure and reliable log forwarding from application and infrastructure layers to observability platforms such as Splunk.
* Helps other developers on the team with technical issues and onboard them to the frameworks
* Partner with development and other project teams to improve the systems process and provide the necessary support with day to day operations
* Migrate older technology implementations to modern a container/Kubernetes platform
* Ensure logs meet compliance, audit, and monitoring requirements; help define and enforce logging standards across environments.
* Primary contributions in Development, Testing Frameworks and Rollout.
* Works under the guidance of Lead Software Engineers, Tech Leads and Architects.
* Research trends in the current technology domain, discover new tools and garner the consensus for internal adoption
* Mentor and train junior and mid-level engineers on the team; assists with technical issues and onboard them to the frameworks

**What Are We Looking For in This Role?**
-----------------------------------------

### **Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in a technical discipline
* Typically Minimum of 6 years years of experience in IT with expertise in complex technology solutions

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Familiarity with container orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes).
* Experience with policy-as-code tools (OPA, policy frameworks).Exposure to security automation (vulnerability scanning, secrets management).
* Understanding of Git branching strategies (GitFlow, trunk-based development).
* GCP/Azure cloud certification
* SAFe certified
* Working with remote teams (onshore, nearshore, offshore)
* Experience with managing a large code base that is a mixture of legacy code and modern technology, preferably experience with moving legacy code to the cloud
* Experience with SF DX
* Experience with continuous integration build engines, such as Jenkins

-------------------------------------------------

* Skills / Knowledge - Having wide-ranging experience, uses professional concepts and company objectives to resolve complex issues in creative and effective ways. Some barriers to entry exist at this level (e.g., dept./peer review).
* Job Complexity - Works on complex issues where analysis of situations or data requires an in-depth evaluation of variable factors. Exercises judgment in selecting methods, techniques and evaluation criteria for obtaining results. Networks with key contacts outside own area of expertise.
* Supervision - Determines methods and procedures on new assignments and may coordinate activities of other personnel (Team Lead).

title: Global Enterprise Support
description:
**About Us:**

At apexanalytix, we’re lifelong innovators! Since the date of our founding nearly four decades ago we’ve been consistently growing, profitable, and delivering the best procure-to-pay solutions to the world. **Job Details**
---------------

**Role Overview**
=================

As an Incident & Support Analyst, you will be the first point of contact for end users, providing hands-on technical support for laptops, desktops, peripherals, and office IT infrastructure. You will handle hardware troubleshooting, laptop imaging, software deployment, and endpoint management through Microsoft Intune to ensure employees have reliable, secure, and well-configured devices.

**Key Responsibilities**
========================

**1. Desktop & Laptop Support**
-------------------------------

* Provide hands-on (deskside) and remote technical support for hardware, software, and peripheral issues.
* Diagnose and resolve issues on Windows and macOS, business applications, printers, and other office equipment.
* Install, configure, and maintain desktops, laptops, monitors, docking stations, and meeting room AV equipment.

**2. Laptop Imaging & Device Provisioning**
-------------------------------------------

* Perform laptop imaging, reimaging, and OS deployment using standard build images and provisioning tools.
* Set up and configure new devices, including hardware, OS, applications, and security configurations.
* Manage device lifecycle: deployment, refresh, and secure decommissioning, with accurate asset records.

**3. Microsoft Intune & Endpoint Management**
---------------------------------------------

* Manage endpoint devices via Microsoft Intune (MDM/MAM) — enrollment, compliance, and configuration profiles.
* Deploy applications, security updates, and patches through Intune and Microsoft endpoint management tools.
* Troubleshoot Intune enrollment, conditional access, and compliance issues; support Autopilot zero-touch provisioning.

**4. Hardware Expertise**
-------------------------

* Diagnose and repair hardware faults; coordinate vendor warranty replacements where required.
* Perform component-level troubleshooting (RAM, SSD, motherboard, battery, display, keyboard, etc.).
* Manage hardware spares inventory and support office network basics (Wi-Fi, switches, cabling, printers).
* Contribute to IT projects such as office moves, new site setups, hardware refreshes, and security rollouts.

**5. Incident Management & Ticketing**
--------------------------------------

* Log, prioritize, and resolve support tickets in line with defined SLAs.
* Escalate complex issues to L2/L3 teams with proper documentation and follow-through to closure.
* Maintain accurate records of incidents, requests, and resolutions in the ticketing system.

**Required Skills and Qualifications**
======================================

* 3–5 years' experience as an Incident & Support Analyst, Desktop Support Engineer, or similar hands-on end-user support role.
* Strong hands-on expertise in laptop and desktop hardware — installation, troubleshooting, and component replacement.
* Experience with laptop imaging tools such as MDT, SCCM, or Windows Autopilot.
* Working knowledge of Microsoft Intune for endpoint management and policy configuration.
* Strong knowledge of Windows 10/11 administration; macOS support a plus.
* Hands-on experience with Microsoft 365, Azure AD / Entra ID, and Active Directory.
* Understanding of basic networking concepts (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VPN, Wi-Fi troubleshooting).
* Experience with IT ticketing/ITSM tools.
* Strong customer service orientation with excellent verbal and written communication skills.

============================

* Bachelor's degree or diploma in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field.
* Certifications such as CompTIA A+, Microsoft MD-102, Microsoft Endpoint Administrator, or ITIL Foundation.
* PowerShell scripting experience for automation of routine tasks.
* Exposure to mobile device management for iOS and Android.
* Familiarity with Microsoft Defender for Endpoint, BitLocker, and antivirus management.

**Work Conditions**
===================

* Primarily on-site role to provide hands-on support at office locations.
* Occasional travel between sites and after-hours support for critical issues or deployments.
* Physical ability to lift and move IT equipment as part of routine duties.

Our goal is to offer the very best benefits possible to you and your loved ones. When it comes to benefits, whether for yourself or your family the most important aspect is choice. * Bachelor's degree or equivalent in information technology, computer science, or a related field is preferred.

Hybrid Working

We are the world's trusted infrastructure consulting firm, partnering with clients to solve the world’s most complex challenges and build legacies for future generations.

We invite you to bring your bold ideas and big dreams and become part of a global team of over 50,000 planners, designers, engineers, scientists, digital innovators, program and construction managers and other professionals delivering projects that create a positive and tangible impact around the world.

We're one global team driven by our common purpose to deliver a better world. Join us.

 **Job Description**

**Shape the future of nature-positive infrastructure.**

Join AECOM's global Nature practice and contribute to some of the UK's most significant infrastructure, renewable energy, water and environmental programmes. As an Assistant Ecologist within our Enterprise Capability team, you will collaborate with internationally recognized experts, gain exposure to global best practice, and develop specialist skills in biodiversity, ecological assessment and nature-based solutions while helping deliver projects that create lasting environmental value. Applications are encouraged by recent graduates and early-career professionals seeking to build a long-term career in ecological and environmental consulting.

Our Enterprise Capability team is a strategic extension of AECOM's global business, delivering services to multidisciplinary projects across the UK and other international markets.

This is a unique opportunity to join a highly respected team of experts and gain exposure to nationally significant projects, including solar farms, energy infrastructure renewals, transport schemes, and water infrastructure upgrades. You will play a key role in supporting ecology projects while developing the technical, analytical and consultancy skills needed for a successful career in nature consulting.

Unlike many graduate ecology roles, this position offers immediate exposure to internationally significant projects, multidisciplinary teams, and global environmental best practice. You will work directly with experienced ecologists, planners, engineers and landscape architects while building consulting skills that are highly valued across international environmental and sustainability markets.

Working remotely as an integrated member of one of our regional ecology teams, you will receive structured training, mentoring and personalised career development support from experienced professionals dedicated to helping you succeed.

**Here’s what you’ll do**

As an Assistant Ecologist, you will contribute to a diverse range of ecological assessments and environmental projects by:

* Conducting desk-based ecological studies, including researching designated sites, habitats, and protected species records.
* Analysing ecological survey data, including bat audio recordings, infrared imagery, and thermal imaging outputs.
* Supporting Biodiversity Net Gain (BNG) assessments and biodiversity offsetting calculations.
* Assisting in the preparation of Ecological Impact Assessments (EcIA), Habitats Regulations Assessments (HRA) and protected species reports.
* Supporting the development of protected species licence applications, habitat management plans, monitoring strategies and ecological mitigation measures.
* Helping coordinate ecological field surveys and supporting project delivery teams across the UK.
* Collaborating with multidisciplinary specialists in GIS, landscape architecture, environmental planning, water and engineering.
* You will also develop expertise in digital ecology tools and international assessment methodologies, including biodiversity metrics, GIS-enabled workflows, ecological data analysis, remote sensing technologies, AI-enabled processes, and global environmental standards.

**Come grow with us**

At AECOM, you'll be part of a thriving Nature business comprising more than 230 specialists across ecology, arboriculture, forestry, groundwater and surface water disciplines. Our team includes recognised industry leaders and technical experts who are shaping the future of environmental consultancy.

You'll benefit from:

* Direct collaboration with ecological specialists across the UK and global regions.
* Exposure to nationally significant infrastructure, renewable energy, transportation and water projects.
* Structured technical learning through formal training programmes and mentoring.
* Access to global knowledge networks and subject matter experts.
* Opportunities to build long-term international consulting careers.
* A culture focused on sustainability, innovation and continuous learning.
* Clear progression pathways from Assistant Ecologist through to Specialist and Project Ecologist roles.

This role is designed as an entry point into AECOM's global Nature practice. Successful candidates will have opportunities to develop into technical specialists, project ecologists and future environmental consulting leaders through structured development programmes and project experience.

 **Qualifications**

**Qualifications**

***Here’s what we’re looking for:***

* Undergraduate degree in a related discipline such as:

* Ecology
* Environmental Science
* Environmental Management
* Zoology
* Botany
* Conservation Biology
* Wildlife Sciences
* Forestry
* Natural Resource Management
* Geography (Environmental)
* Sustainability Studies
* Earth and Environmental Sciences

Or a related subject

* Passion for ecology and environmental conservation.
* Good understanding of core ecological principles, including:
* Ecological survey and assessment methods
* Ecological impact assessment principles
* Mitigation hierarchy
* Habitat management and restoration
* Ecosystem services and nature recovery concepts

Knowledge of Biodiversity Net Gain and biodiversity offsetting approaches is advantageous but not essential.

**Desirable**

* Familiarity with GIS platforms such as ArcGIS or QGIS.
* Exposure to ecological data analysis and reporting tools.
* Experience gained through internships, academic projects or research activities.

* Strong technical writing and report preparation skills.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to work independently while contributing effectively within a team environment.
* Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage priorities and work within project budgets.

Experience of ecological consultancy, a knowledge of UK nature conservation legislation; and an understanding of UK habitats and protected species are desirable but not essential.

We welcome candidates with strong ecological foundations and a willingness to learn international environmental consulting practices.

At AECOM, we are committed to delivering a better world through sustainable infrastructure, environmental stewardship and climate resilience. We invest in our people through continuous learning, mentorship and opportunities to work on projects that make a positive difference to communities and ecosystems worldwide.

title: Radio Engineer II
description:
**Overview**
------------

We are seeking an experienced Radio Engineer II to deliver radiofrequency and wireless system designs for railway, metro, light rail, depot, station, tunnel and building projects. The successful candidate will be an expert user of Ekahau and iBwave, with international experience in predictive modelling, surveys, coverage analysis, design optimisation and technical assurance.

**Your Role**
-------------

* Develop concept, tender and detailed designs for Wi-Fi, TETRA, public-safety radio, cellular DAS, LTE/5G, private mobile radio and other project-specific wireless systems.
* Prepare radio and wireless architectures for stations, platforms, tunnels, depots, workshops, stabling areas, control centres, trackside areas and buildings.
* Perform RF propagation modelling, coverage and capacity analysis, interference assessment, frequency/channel planning, link-budget calculations, and design optimisation.
* Determine access-point, antenna, remote-radio-unit and repeater locations based on project requirements, validated survey inputs and applicable design criteria.
* Design passive and active DAS solutions, including antennas, feeders, splitters, couplers, combiners, cable routes and associated equipment.
* Coordinate designs with architecture, civil, MEP, signalling, rolling stock, operations, security, fire and life safety, and IT/network disciplines.
* Prepare design reports, architecture and block diagrams, heat maps, coverage plots, equipment schedules, BOQ/BOM, specifications, interface documents and as-built records.
* Prepare and review survey, FAT, SAT, coverage-acceptance and commissioning procedures;
* Lead assigned design packages and provide technical guidance to CAD/BIM designers for Radio drawings.
* Software and RF Design Expertise

*Ekahau*

* Create predictive Wi-Fi models using floor plans, wall types, attenuation values, antenna characteristics and project design criteria.
* Perform access-point placement, channel and power planning, capacity modelling and coverage validation for high-density and operationally critical environments.
* Plan and perform passive, active and spectrum surveys; analyse results and prepare professional survey and validation reports.

*iBwave*

* Develop iBwave models for in-building radio, cellular, public-safety and mission-critical coverage in buildings, stations, tunnels and depots.
* Configure building geometry, construction materials, RF sources, antennas and propagation parameters for reliable predictive modelling.
* Prepare DAS schematics, riser diagrams, equipment layouts, cable schedules, link budgets and coverage-compliance reports, coordinated with CAD/BIM deliverables.

*Mandatory Technical Skills*

* Expert practical experience with Ekahau for predictive Wi-Fi design, survey planning, survey analysis and reporting.
* Expert practical experience with iBwave for in-building radio, DAS and RF coverage design.
* Strong knowledge of RF propagation, path loss, fading, attenuation, link budgets, antenna characteristics, interference, signal quality and capacity planning.
* Design experience in Wi-Fi and at least two of the following: TETRA, public-safety radio, cellular DAS, LTE/5G, private mobile radio or tunnel radio.
* Experience with indoor and outdoor wireless surveys, RF test methods and coverage acceptance.
* Ability to interpret architectural, civil, MEP, railway and telecom drawings and coordinate within AutoCAD/Revit/BIM environments.
* Knowledge of IP networking, VLANs, QoS, PoE and fibre connectivity supporting wireless systems.
* Knowledge of relevant standards and guidelines, including IEEE 802.11 Wi-Fi standards, ETSI and Ofcom/FCC regulations, EN 50121 EMC requirements, and applicable railway telecommunications standards.
* Experience in radio systems, including leaky feeder, radiating cable, tunnel DAS, distributed antenna systems, and emergency communications coverage.
* Understanding of interfaces with SCADA, signalling, PA/VA, CCTV, passenger information systems, operational telephony, and transmission networks.
* Strong technical writing, design-calculation, stakeholder coordination and multidisciplinary communication skills.

*Rail and International Experience*

* Demonstrated radio design experience on railway, metro, light rail, station, depot, tunnel or transportation-infrastructure projects.
* Demonstrated wireless design experience for complex or high-occupancy buildings.
* Experience delivering projects across multiple countries or regions and working with geographically distributed teams.
* Ability to apply project requirements, client standards, local regulations and international engineering practices.

**About You**
-------------

* Bachelor's degree in Telecommunications, Electronics Engineering or a related engineering discipline.
* 7-10 years of relevant radio, wireless or RF design experience, including substantial hands-on use of Ekahau and iBwave.
* Proven experience producing complete radio-design deliverables for both rail and building environments.
* Relevant Ekahau and/or iBwave certification is preferred; vendor wireless certification is desirable.
* Ability to work independently and deliver accurate work within approved scope, programme and budget.
* Willingness to support international projects, client meetings and site activities where required.
