title: Senior Hardware Engineer (Railways & Embedded Systems)
description:
**Company Overview**We are a fast-growing **MSME Engineering company** dedicated to delivering cutting-edge, mission-critical electronic systems for the defense and transport sectors, with a heavy focus on **Indian Railways** applications. As we scale, we are seeking a highly skilled and independent engineer to champion our hardware lifecycle from concept to field deployment.**Role Objective**The **Senior Hardware Engineer** will independently handle the end-to-end design, development, and validation of complex ruggedized electronic systems. You will lead a lean engineering team, ensuring all products comply strictly with **RDSO specifications** and international railway standards.

**Key Product Ownership**You will be the primary custodian for the design and manufacturing support of:

* **Safety & Communication:** Crew Voice and Video Recording (CVVR) systems, UHF Radio Communication, Voice over IP (VoIP), GPS & GSM technologies.
* **Train Networking:** Train Communication Network (TCN VCU), Train Control Management System (TCMS), MVB, and Radio Signals MVB.
* **Monitoring & Automation:** On-Board Condition Monitoring Systems (OBCMS), Remote Monitoring Systems, Coach Under-Slung Water Level Indicators, Cameras, M-NVRs, and rugged PoE Switches.

**Requirements & Technical Qualifications**

**Education & Experience**

* **Education:** Bachelor’s Degree (B.E./B.Tech) in **Electronic Engineering** or higher.
* **Experience:** Minimum **6+ years** of core hardware design and manufacturing experience, with at least **2 years as a Lead Engineer**.

**Core Technical Skills**

* **Microcontrollers & Processors:** In-depth programming and architecture knowledge of 8-bit, 16-bit, 32-bit, and **ARM microcontrollers**, DSPs, and Intel motherboards.
* **Circuit Design:** Expertise in **Analog and Digital circuit design** (DSP, FPGA), System-on-Module (SoM) architecture, and control electronics for embedded systems.
* **High-Speed Design:** Proven experience in High-Speed Board Design, Signal Integrity (SI), FPGA code development/validation, PCIe bus design, simulation, and DC Power circuit design.
* **Communication Interfaces:** Practical design and debugging experience with **CAN, PCIe, USB, Ethernet, RS485, and RS232**.
* **EDA Tools:** Advanced proficiency in Electronic Design Automation (EDA) tools for schematic capture, PCB layout support, hardware bring-up, and bench-top validation.

**Standards, Testing & Compliance**

* **Railway Standards:** Thorough working knowledge of Indian Railways **RDSO specifications** and international train electronic standards, including:
* **IEC 60571 / EN 50155** (Electronic equipment used on rolling stock)
* **IEC 61375** (Train Communication Network / MVB)
* **EMI/EMC:** Solid track record of implementing **EMI/EMC mitigation solutions** and passing validation as per IEC standards.
* **Hardware Architecture:** Direct exposure to test protocols for industrial/railway grade cameras, M-NVRs, and network switches.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Product Lifecycle Management:** Drive product development independently from initial block diagram to final manufacturing-ready files (Gerbers, BOM, Assembly drawings).
* **Compliance Leadership:** Architect systems to natively pass harsh environmental, thermal, and electrical tests dictated by RDSO/IS/IEC protocols.
* **Triage & Troubleshooting:** Act as the technical anchor to debug, root-cause, and resolve complex hardware anomalies working seamlessly with cross-functional software and firmware teams.
* **Mentorship:** Guide junior engineers through schematic reviews, simulation checks, and strict validation methodologies.

Pay: ₹686,000.00 - ₹1,500,000.00 per year

Work Location: In person

description:
**About the Role**
==================

We are looking for an Engineer II in System Validation Testing with 3 to 5 years of experience to join our cloud network management quality engineering team. The role focuses on hands-on testing of a cloud-hosted platform used to onboard, configure, monitor and manage networking devices such as access points, switches and routers.

The engineer will work with senior QA engineers, developers and product teams to understand requirements, design and execute tests, automate repeatable workflows, investigate failures and contribute to reliable releases across the device, network, cloud, API and web or mobile application layers.

**Key Responsibilities**
========================

**Cloud Network Management Testing**
------------------------------------

* Understand feature requirements and expected customer workflows for cloud-managed access points, switches and routers.
* Test device onboarding, discovery, provisioning, configuration and removal workflows.
* Validate device-to-cloud communication, cloud-to-device operations and configuration synchronization.
* Test device status, statistics, alerts, notifications and basic remote-management workflows.
* Validate firmware upgrade, reconnect, recovery and factory-reset scenarios under guidance.
* Execute tests across common LAN, WAN, Wi-Fi and multi-device network setups.

**Test Planning and Execution**
-------------------------------

* Review user stories, acceptance criteria and functional specifications with the QA team.
* Create and maintain clear test scenarios and test cases covering positive, negative, boundary and recovery conditions.
* Prepare test data and configure required devices, accounts, subscriptions and environments.
* Execute functional, integration, system, regression, compatibility and end-to-end tests.
* Record results accurately, report coverage gaps and escalate blockers early.
* Retest resolved defects and run focused regression for impacted workflows.

**API Cloud and Data Validation**
---------------------------------

* Test REST APIs using tools such as Postman and automation libraries.
* Validate request and response data, status codes, authentication, authorization and error handling.
* Verify consistency across APIs, backend services, database records and user interfaces.
* Test asynchronous operations, events and notifications with support from senior engineers.
* Use AWS logs, dashboards and application telemetry to investigate test failures.
* Perform smoke and regression validation in QA and staging environments.

**Networking and Troubleshooting**
----------------------------------

* Apply networking fundamentals including TCP/IP, IPv4 and IPv6, DHCP, DNS, ARP, ICMP, HTTP and HTTPS, VLANs, routing, switching, NAT, LAN, WAN and Wi-Fi.
* Use ping, traceroute, nslookup or dig, iperf, browser developer tools and device or cloud logs during troubleshooting.
* Capture and perform basic analysis of network traffic using Wireshark or tcpdump.
* Isolate whether a failure is related to the device, network, cloud service, API, backend or application layer, and involve the appropriate team.

**Test Automation**
-------------------

* Develop and maintain Python-based automation for APIs, device workflows and regression scenarios.
* Create or update UI automation using Playwright, Selenium or an equivalent framework.
* Follow existing framework standards and build reusable, readable and maintainable test components.
* Analyze automation failures, distinguish product defects from script or environment issues and fix tests within assigned scope.
* Run automated suites through CI/CD pipelines and report failures with supporting evidence.
* Identify stable, repetitive manual scenarios suitable for automation.

**Defect Management and Team Collaboration**
--------------------------------------------

* Log clear defects with reproducible steps, expected and actual behavior, logs, screenshots, API traces and packet captures when applicable.
* Participate in defect triage, daily stand-ups, sprint planning and test-status discussions.
* Collaborate with software, cloud, firmware, networking and mobile teams to reproduce and resolve issues.
* Track assigned defects through retest and closure and communicate risks or delays promptly.
* Maintain test cases, automation and technical notes in the agreed repositories and tools.

**Release and Production Support**
----------------------------------

* Support release regression, production smoke testing and post-deployment validation as assigned.
* Verify critical customer workflows after deployments and provide accurate test status to the QA lead.
* Assist with reproducing customer-reported or production issues in controlled environments.
* Contribute new regression tests for escaped defects and recurring failure patterns.

**Required Qualifications**
===========================

* 3 to 5 years of software QA or system validation experience.
* Hands-on experience in functional, integration, regression and end-to-end testing.
* Working knowledge of TCP/IP and core networking concepts.
* Experience testing REST APIs and interpreting JSON request and response data.
* Programming or test-automation experience using Python.
* Exposure to UI automation using Playwright, Selenium or an equivalent tool.
* Ability to analyze logs, reproduce issues and write clear defect reports.

**Job Description**

Job Purpose :

Data Platform Services is building a modern, governed, metadata-driven business data fabric powered by SAP Datasphere and the broader SAP Business Data Cloud (BDC) / SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP) ecosystem. This platform spans cross-system ingestion, semantic data layering, long-term persistence/archiving, and governed consumption across multiple downstream analytical and operational engines.

We are seeking a DataOps Engineer who treats spaces, data pipelines, replication flows, and semantic models as configuration, not one-off manual builds — someone who has designed or maintained environments where central metadata and rule tables drive how data assets are onboarded, transformed, partitioned, secured, and federated, rather than hand-crafting individual spaces and views from scratch.

You will operate across the full data lifecycle: hybrid ingestion/replication (landing persisted business layer cold store/archive), lifecycle and storage tiering strategies, and the dynamic routing engine that provides filtered, masked, and context-rich semantic views to multiple downstream consumers.

Key Responsibilities..

* Build and operate resilient real-time and batch ingestion pipelines within SAP Datasphere using Replication Flows, Data Flows, and Transformation Flows from SAP (S/4HANA, ECC, BW/4HANA, SAP BDC) and non-SAP cloud/lake sources.
* Design and maintain metadata-driven Space and Pipeline generation — where onboarding a new source entity, defining business semantics, or establishing delta replication is driven by configuration registries, templates, and CLI/API automation rather than manual UI workflows.
* Implement retention and data tiering strategies using Datasphere cold storage integration, partition-based retention, and hybrid connectivity to external cloud object stores (e.g., ADLS Gen2, AWS S3, Snowflake).
* Build and maintain a governed routing & semantic distribution engine: leverage a metadata rules registry (splittable, target\_consumers[], row\_filter\_expr, column\_mask\_expr) to programmatically build and manage Data Access Controls (DAC), Analytic Models, and Consumption Views across Spaces.
* Own Datasphere & BDC platform governance: architect Space hierarchies, user privileges, Space-to-Space sharing topologies, catalog registrations, and cross-system business context lineages.
* Drive DataOps & CI/CD automation: manage automated asset lifecycle and deployment across environments (Dev/Test/Prod) leveraging Datasphere CLI, Content Network packages, REST APIs, and Git-integrated repositories.
* Monitor platform health & replication telemetry: track replication lag, task execution logs, memory/storage consumption quotas across Spaces, and semantic view performance; build proactive alerting for SLA breaches and data drift.
* Collaborate with SAP functional/data modeling teams to align on semantic consistency (CDS views, business context, ODP extractors) and translate consumer access requirements into secure, performant consumption models.
* Document architecture, data flow patterns, and security topologies to maintain enterprise compliance and accelerate developer onboarding.

Required Skills & Experience

Core Platform & SAP Datasphere / BDC

* Hands-on experience with SAP Datasphere (formerly Data Warehouse Cloud) and/or SAP BDC / BTP Data Services.
* Strong hands-on expertise with Datasphere core artifacts: Spaces, Connections (DP Agent, Cloud Connectors), Replication Flows, Data Flows, Transformation Flows, View Modeling (Graphical & SQL/Script), and Analytic Models.
* Deep understanding of SAP source integration patterns: CDS Views, ODP/Extractors, SAP Landscape Transformation (SLT), S/4HANA integrations, and federation vs. replication trade-offs.
* Strong proficiency in SQL and SAP HANA Cloud engine concepts (calculation views, indexing, execution plan analysis, in-memory optimization).

Metadata-Driven Engineering & Automation (Critical)

* Proven experience building or maintaining metadata/config-driven integration frameworks — where schemas, replication tasks, or security policies are programmatically driven by configuration tables or parameterized templates.
* Experience with SAP Datasphere Command Line Interface (datasphere CLI), REST APIs, or Python scripts to automate tenant management, Space provisioning, CSN/JSON definition generation, and user onboarding.
* Strong understanding of keeping semantic models and DAC rules synchronized with an authoritative source-of-truth metadata repository.

Platform Engineering / DataOps

* CI/CD & Lifecycle Management: Hands-on experience with Datasphere Content Network, transport management, and version-controlled deployment pipelines (Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, or GitLab CI).
* Scripting & Orchestration: Strong scripting skills (Python, PowerShell, Bash) and experience with enterprise orchestrators (Airflow, Azure Data Factory, Control-M, or SAP BTP job scheduling).
* Observability & Performance Tuning: Experience monitoring space storage quotas, replication queues, performance optimization of complex joined views, and setting up automated incident alerts.

Governance & Security

* Deep expertise in Datasphere Data Access Controls (DAC), object-level authorizations, row-level filters, and column-level masking for sensitive/PII data.
* Familiarity with enterprise cataloging and metadata lineage (SAP Datasphere Catalog, SAP Purview connector, Collibra, or Alation).
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to bridge the gap between technical data engineering and business analytics teams.

Nice to Have

* Experience with SAP Analytics Cloud (SAC) integration and Live Connection optimization.
* Experience with SAP HANA Cloud / HDI Containers and native HANA database artifacts.
* Hands-on knowledge of cloud lakehouse platforms (Databricks, Snowflake, Azure Synapse, Fabric) connected via Open Data Mesh / Federation to Datasphere.
* Familiarity with SAP BTP global account and subaccount administration, Cloud Identity Services (IAS), and single sign-on (SSO).

What Success Looks Like in the First 6 Months

* Config-Driven Asset Deployment: New entity ingestion and Space provisioning are automated via configuration tables and CLI scripts, minimizing manual UI modeling.
* Automated Security & Access: Data Access Control (DAC) generation and Space-sharing policies operate seamlessly based on centralized security metadata.
* Optimized Storage & Replication: Automated data tiering, delta replication monitoring, and partition pruning are established and operating reliably across production spaces.
* End-to-End DataOps Pipeline: CI/CD deployment routines across Dev/Test/Prod environments are fully automated with zero manual transport bottlenecks.

Designs and governs API-led and event-driven integration architectures using REST, GraphQL, OData, SAP integration patterns, and enterprise messaging solutions.

  
  

**Commercial Awareness**

Shapes squad structures, tech-lead roles, and engineering capacity for complex programmes. Develop an inclusive, high-performing engineering culture through technical leadership and collaboration.

  
  

**Growing People**

Mentors engineers across grades and supports succession planning. Promotes standard methodologies, maintainable code, clear documentation, and high-quality work.

  
  

**Change Leadership**

Leads engineering transformation and adoption of modern practices, including DevSecOps, SRE, platform engineering, cloud-native delivery, composable architecture, and AI-assisted development. Ensures quality in enterprise platform engineering at the squad level and owns the engineering narrative for change.

* Strong experience building, leading, and running high-performance engineering teams, with a focus on reliability, automation, operational excellence, and customer success.
* Deep knowledge of ITIL, Agile, DevSecOps, and enterprise technology governance frameworks.
* Hands-on software engineering experience, including test driven development, automated testing, CI/CD, code quality management, and modern engineering practices.
* Strong understanding of B2B commerce and customer portal capabilities, including Product Catalog Management, Product Modelling, Inventory Availability, Shopping Cart and Checkout, Order Management, Search and Browse, SEO, and Personalisation.
* Strong experience integrating customer engagement and commerce platforms with SAP ERP/S/4HANA using IDoc, BAPI, OData, RFC, SAP CPI/BTP, APIs, and event-driven integration patterns.

* Experience leading delivery through vendor and SI partner ecosystems, holding partners accountable for engineering quality, timelines, architecture compliance, and delivery outcomes.
* Experience designing and delivering global, multi-country, multi-currency, and multi-language B2B commerce and customer portal solutions.

**Essential Skills**

title: Resident Engineer - ALSPA Turbine Control System Specialist
description:
The Resident Engineer will provide on-site technical support for the ALSPA System, ensuring efficient operation, maintenance, and troubleshooting. The role is critical to delivering responsive engineering support and strengthening customer engagement at a strategic nuclear facility. The position requires a permanent on-site presence at the Kakrapar Atomic Power Station, with the engineer working on a daily basis within the plant premises.

**Candidate will perform the following on-site activities:**

  

* Facilitate knowledge transfer to Customer team through the diagnosis routine faults, alarm analysis, system health checks, configuration verification, and assistance during normal operation.

* Assist in Spare Parts Identification or license/patch upgrade.
* Supervision of execution of changes applied in ALSPA Controsteam Control System
* Implementation of approved software changes.
* From minor alterations to new approved mimic creations.
* Configuration of Hardware for Operator Workstations (OWS) and Engineering Workstations (EWS) such as Windows, tools/functions/patches Installation and firmware update of controller and modules (for Repair).

* Configuration of TMR cards (AI , DI, DO and Network Cards), speed cards, MFC cards ,
* Modules (AI, DI, DO AO) or any other as applicable for the supplied control system.
* Explanation of logic block which are used in logic creation of turbine protection, governing and auxiliary system.
* Act as the single point of contact between NPCIL and PSIPL engineering teams.
* Coordinate remote engineering support, including design clarifications, advanced Troubleshooting, and technical advice for the OEM supplied ALSPA Contro-steam Control System.

title: Lead Engineer - Network & Security
description:
**Presidio, Where Teamwork and Innovation Shape the Future**  
At Presidio, we're at the forefront of a global technology revolution, transforming industries through cutting-edge digital solutions and next-generation AI. We empower businesses - and their internal customers - to achieve more through innovation, automation, and intelligent insights.

**The Role**

* Design, configure, implement, test, and support enterprise routing, switching, software-defined networking, and network security solutions
* Participate in customer discovery sessions and technical workshops to document requirements, dependencies, constraints, and success criteria
* Develop and maintain technical designs, implementation procedures, migration plans, test plans, rollback procedures, and as-built documentation
* Build and support resilient networks across campus, data center, lab, branch, cloud-connected, and hybrid environments
* Configure and troubleshoot routing protocols, VLANs, network segmentation, redundancy, high availability, quality of service, and common network services
* Implement and support software-defined networking and network virtualization solutions under established architecture and design standards
* Configure and support network security controls, including firewalls, secure remote access, segmentation, access policies, and secure connectivity between environments
* Perform advanced troubleshooting, collect and analyze diagnostic information, identify root causes, and coordinate resolution with internal teams and vendors
* Plan and execute approved lifecycle activities, including software upgrades, firmware upgrades, hardware refreshes, configuration updates, and post-change validation
* Support Presidio lab network and security infrastructure used for engineering, demonstrations, proofs of concept, validation, training, and customer-facing activities
* Maintain lab configurations, diagrams, inventories, access records, standards, and operational documentation to promote repeatability and reduce configuration drift
* Serve as a technical point of contact for assigned projects and workstreams, providing clear status updates, technical recommendations, and escalation of risks or blockers
* Coordinate implementation activities with customers, project managers, vendors, facilities teams, remote hands, and other engineering disciplines

**Technology/Area of Specialization:**

* Strong knowledge of enterprise routing and switching, including dynamic routing protocols, Layer 2 and Layer 3 design, redundancy, segmentation, quality of service, and network services
* Working knowledge of software-defined networking, policy-based networking, network virtualization, automation, and centralized management platforms
* Practical knowledge of network security technologies, including firewalls, VPNs, secure access, segmentation, access control, policy enforcement, and security monitoring integrations

**Basic Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:**

* Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to explain technical topics to customers, project teams, and internal stakeholders

* Ability to lead defined technical workstreams while collaborating with senior architects and engineering leadership on complex decisions

**Required Skills:**

* Experience coordinating technical activities with customers, project teams, vendors, and internal stakeholders
* Demonstrated ability to provide technical guidance or mentoring to junior engineers
* Relevant professional-level networking or security certifications are preferred

**Your future at Presidio**  
Joining Presidio means stepping into a culture of trailblazers - thinkers, builders, and collaborators - who push the boundaries of what's possible. With our expertise AI-driven analytics, cloud solutions, cybersecurity, and next-gen infrastructure, we enable businesses to stay ahead in an ever-evolving digital world.

Here, your impact is real. Whether you're harnessing the power of Generative AI, architecting resilient digital ecosystems, or driving data-driven transformation, you'll be part of a team that is shaping the future.

**Ready to innovate? Let's redefine what's next-together.**

  

**About Presidio**  
Presidio is committed to hiring the most qualified candidates to join our amazing culture. We aim to attract and hire top talent from all backgrounds, including underrepresented and marginalized communities. title: Engineer III - Communication
description:
We are looking for an experienced **Engineer III** specializing in **Embedded, Cloud, and Networking Technologies**. In this role, you will bridge the gap between low-level hardware/firmware, edge device networking, and cloud-native ingestion platforms. You will design, build, and deploy secure, end-to-end connected device ecosystems—from microcontrollers and Linux gateways up to real-time telemetry analytics in the cloud.

### **Key Responsibilities**

* **Firmware & Embedded Software Development:** Write, test, and optimize production-grade firmware (C/C++, FreeRTOS, Embedded Linux) for edge microcontrollers, sensors, and gateway devices (e.g., ESP32, STM32, Raspberry Pi, custom SBCs).
* **Network & Connectivity Layer Integration:** Implement secure communication protocols (MQTT/TLS, CoAP, WebSockets, gRPC, TCP/IP) and interface with physical transport networks (Wi-Fi, Cellular/LTE, BLE, LoRaWAN, Ethernet).
* **Cloud Platform Integration:** Connect edge fleets to cloud IoT backends (AWS IoT Core, Azure IoT Hub, GCP IoT) and build pipeline logic for device provisioning, remote management, Over-The-Air (OTA) firmware updates, and time-series telemetry processing.
* **Full-Stack & Dashboards:** Develop microservices (Node.js, Python/FastAPI) and front-end monitoring tools (React) to visualize fleet health, telemetry logs, and control remote edge assets in real time.
* **Security & Device Identity:** Implement hardware-root-of-trust security, X.509 certificate provisioning, end-to-end encryption, and secure boot across embedded devices and cloud API gateways.
* **DevOps, Automation & CI/CD:** Build containerized edge deployments (Docker, AWS Greengrass, Azure IoT Edge) and set up continuous integration/deployment (CI/CD) pipelines for firmware and cloud releases.
* **Field Testing & System Validation:** Lead integration testing on physical hardware setups, simulate adverse network conditions (latency, intermittent drops), and support operational detachments or field-site deployments for root-cause diagnosis.

If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry.


If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.

**Are you ready to be part of the future?**

**About the job**


Cosmic AC is Tether Data's GPU compute and managed inference platform: GPU containers, managed inference endpoints and platform observability, delivered as a self\-hosted package on Kubernetes, with a control plane written in JavaScript. The platform is expanding from orchestrating workloads on a managed cluster to owning the full stack on bare\-metal GPU infrastructure: a managed Slurm scheduling layer for internal research and model\-training teams first, and our own Kubernetes control plane for inference tenancy after that.


The Technical Lead owns the architecture and delivery of that stack and leads the engineering team building it: about twelve engineers across backend, frontend, DevOps, QA and documentation, distributed across Europe and India. The role reports to the Senior Technical Product Manager for Cosmic AC, who owns scope, sequencing and partner commitments; the Technical Lead owns architecture, implementation and delivery plans, line\-manages the engineers, and is the primary technical interface to our infrastructure partners.


This is a hands\-on infrastructure leadership role with a fixed delivery window in its first six months. It is not a research role, not a pure Kubernetes SRE role, and not a management\-only role.

**Responsibilities**

**Architecture****.** Own the platform architecture end to end: architecture proposals, high\-level and low\-level designs, driven through review and kept current as the baseline.

**Team leadership.** Lead and line\-manage a distributed team across backend (Node.js), frontend (React), DevOps, QA and documentation: engineering standards, code and design review, release gates, one\-to\-ones, growth and performance input.

**Bare\-metal GPU scheduling layer**. Design, build and operate a managed Slurm service for research users: controller and accounting, partitions and login nodes, node onboarding and acceptance, driver and CUDA baseline and upgrades, stalled\-job and node\-health detection, drain and autohealing, storage visibility, identity and isolation.

**Kubernetes control plane and GPU enablement.** Own cluster bootstrap and lifecycle on partner\-provided bare metal, NVIDIA GPU Operator and Network Operator, VM\-based GPU isolation (KubeVirt and VFIO), and day\-2 operations: upgrades, backup and recovery, node replacement.

**Managed inference at scale.** Serving architecture, multi\-GPU and multi\-node parallelism, autoscaling, request routing and endpoint reliability; confidential\-compute\-capable capacity for sensitive workloads.

**Observability and operations.** Metrics, logging, alerting and SLOs across control plane, GPU fleet and application tiers; incident response and post\-incident review; an on\-call model a small team can sustain.

**Partners and vendors.** Primary technical interface to infrastructure partners and vendors: turning requirements into written specifications and acceptance tests, running escalations to closure, and providing technical input to capacity planning and hardware sourcing.

**Internal consumers.** Work directly with research, model\-training and product teams to translate their workloads into platform requirements, and broker capacity when it is short.

**Hiring**. Complete the platform team and set the technical bar for the engineers who join it.

 **Must have**

* **Experience.** Eight or more years of hands\-on engineering, including at least three leading teams that build and operate infrastructure platforms other teams depend on. Bachelor's or Master's degree in computer science or engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
* **Slurm at scale, hands on.** Has run slurmctld and slurmdbd for real users: partitions, QoS and priority, accounting, prolog and epilog, node health scripting, upgrades with jobs on the system. Ideally has operated an HPC or GPU training cluster for a research population.
* **GPU fleet operation on bare metal.** NVIDIA driver and CUDA lifecycle, Fabric Manager and NVSwitch behaviour on SXM systems, DCGM\-based health and utilisation, MIG, node burn\-in and acceptance.
* **High\-performance interconnects.** InfiniBand fabric and subnet configuration, RDMA, SR\-IOV, and diagnosing multi\-node NCCL performance problems.
* **Linux systems depth**. Kernel modules and drivers, PCIe passthrough and vfio\-pci, cgroups and namespaces, performance tuning for compute\-heavy workloads.
* **Production Kubernetes operation, not just deployment:** control plane, upgrades, CNI and CSI, operators and custom controllers, multi\-tenancy design.
* **HPC storage and data movement.** Shared filesystems (VAST, Lustre, NFS), node\-local NVMe caching, distributing large model weights and datasets across many nodes.
* **Observability and operations.** Prometheus, Grafana and Loki or equivalents, SLOs, incident response and post\-incident review.
* **Working fluency in JavaScript and** **Node.js** sufficient to review a control plane, CLI and worker services with authority and to make architecture decisions on them. Not a feature\-development requirement.
* **A shipped platform with real users.** A multi\-tenant IaaS or PaaS, or a research computing service: resource isolation, quotas, usage metering, and user\-facing API and CLI surfaces.
* **Leadership that stays in the code.** People management across time zones, cross\-track review, written architecture decisions with alternatives recorded, and the ability to tell a partner or an executive no with reasons.
* **Excellent written and spoken English.** Most partner and leadership work happens in writing.
* **Location**. Fully remote, based between UTC and UTC\+5:30 so the working day overlaps both Europe and India, where the team and its partners work. Occasional travel to partner sites and team events.

**Desirable**

* Slurm operators on Kubernetes (Soperator, Slinky) or Kubernetes\-native schedulers (Kueue, Volcano, KAI, Kubeflow Trainer).
* Modern serving stacks (vLLM, SGLang, TensorRT\-LLM): parallelism strategies, quantisation trade\-offs, GPU memory planning.
* VM and container isolation for multi\-tenant GPU compute (KubeVirt, Kata Containers, QEMU and KVM, Firecracker); confidential computing (Intel TDX, AMD SEV\-SNP, NVIDIA confidential\-compute mode).
* Cluster API and kubeadm, Cilium, NVSentinel\-class autohealing, infrastructure as code and GitOps.
* Time on the operator side of a GPU cloud, a national or university HPC centre, or an AI lab's platform team.
* Peer\-to\-peer or distributed\-systems background.
* Experience with a hardware provider who provisions but does not operate, and turning that relationship into a written contract with acceptance tests.

**Important information for candidates**  

Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

* **Apply only through our official channels.** We do not use third\-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page: https://tether.recruitee.com/
* **Verify the recruiter’s identity.** All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.
* **Be cautious of unusual communication methods.** We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.
* **Double\-check email addresses.** All communication from us will come from emails ending in **@**tether.to **or @**tether.io
* **We will never request payment or financial details.** If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

**When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.**

Minimum of 15 years of formal education \- Graduate / Post Graduate in Commerce.


Professional work experience of 2 to 3 years.

title: Virtual Network Operator
description:
**Who We Are**

At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission\-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI\-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well\-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive.  



  

**The Role**

our role


The VNOC Operator is the first operational line of the remote AV service and is responsible for continuously monitoring the meeting\-room estate, responding to alerts and incidents, carrying out structured initial diagnosis and performing approved remote remediation.


The Operator owns the operational progression of incidents. The role does not require deep engineering expertise across every AV technology. Instead, the Operator is expected to understand meeting\-room technology sufficiently to interpret alerts, identify the likely area of failure, execute documented diagnostic and remediation procedures, validate recovery and escalate effectively when the issue exceeds defined support boundaries.


The role is designed to be repeatable and scalable within a 24x7 operations environment.  



  

What you will do


Monitor AV and Microsoft Teams Room infrastructure using Utelogy U\-Manage/U\-Managed and other authorised monitoring platforms. Respond to device\-health alerts, offline events, service degradation and user\-reported AV incidents. Qualify monitoring alerts to distinguish genuine incidents from transient events, duplicate alerts, maintenance activity or known conditions. Create, categorise, prioritise and maintain accurate incident records within the ITSM platform. Perform initial diagnosis using approved troubleshooting procedures, monitoring data, device status information, logs and remote\-management tools. Establish the likely fault domain, for example: ( MTR compute, controller/touch panel, camera microphone/audio, display network connectivity, AV peripheral, room\-control system).


Carry out approved remote remediation including activities such as device restart, service restart, connection re\-establishment and other documented recovery actions. Validate service recovery following remediation rather than closing incidents solely because an alert has cleared. Manage incidents in accordance with agreed priority, SLA and escalation requirements. Recognize incidents requiring SME, onsite engineer, Microsoft/M365, network or other resolver\-group intervention. Escalate incidents with sufficient diagnostic information to enable the receiving team to act without unnecessarily repeating first\-line investigation. Maintain ownership and visibility of incidents until resolution or formal transfer of ownership in accordance with the service operating model. Communicate incident status clearly to resolver groups, service\-management teams and other stakeholders. Follow and provide feedback on knowledge articles, troubleshooting procedures and operational runbooks. Identify repeated alert patterns or recurring incidents and flag these for SME/problem\-management review.


**Your Future at Kyndryl**  

Every position at Kyndryl offers a way forward to grow your career. We have opportunities that you won’t find anywhere else, including hands\-on experience, learning opportunities, and the chance to certify in all four major platforms. Whether you want to broaden your knowledge base or narrow your scope and specialize in a specific sector, you can find your opportunity here.  



  

**Who You Are**

You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer\-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others.


**Required skills and experience**

* 1\-3 Years of experience in Virtual Network Operations.
* Strong Microsoft Teams Rooms (MTR) and AV Support Knowledge Demonstrated understanding of Microsoft Teams Rooms environments, including room compute devices, cameras, microphones, displays, speakers, touch panels, and other common AV technologies.
* AV Troubleshooting and Fault Isolation Skills Ability to understand AV signal flow and perform structured fault\-finding to quickly determine whether issues relate to audio, video, control systems, compute devices, or network connectivity.
* Monitoring and Remote Operations Experience: Experience working with monitoring and NOC platforms, including remote management and support tools. Knowledge of Utelogy is advantageous but not essential.
* IT Service Management and Incident Handling, Experience using ITSM platforms such as ServiceNow, with a solid understanding of incident categorization, prioritization, SLA management, escalation processes, and execution of technical runbooks.
* Networking and Infrastructure Fundamentals, Basic understanding of IP networking concepts, including IP addressing, DNS, DHCP, connectivity testing, ping diagnostics, and interpretation of network status and device health indicators.
* Device Management and Technical Analysis, Ability to collect, analyze, and interpret logs, alerts, telemetry, and device health information, together with a working knowledge of Windows\-based meeting room and collaboration devices.
* Relevant Support and Operations Background, Suitable experience may include AV Support Analyst, AV Service Desk, UC/Collaboration Support, Microsoft Teams Support, NOC Analyst, Technical Service Desk with meeting\-room support responsibilities, or a Junior AV Engineer transitioning into remote operations.

  

  

**Preferred skills and experience**

* Experience with one or more of: Utelogy/Microsoft Teams Rooms Pro Management/Logitech Sync/Logitech Rally/Rally Bar/Tap products/Lenovo Teams Room solutions/Q\-SYS/Crestron/Shure conferencing products/AV\-over\-IP/Dante/HDMI/HDBaseT/Enterprise monitoring or NOC environments.
* The Operator does not need deep engineering knowledge of Crestron programming, Q\-SYS DSP design, Dante network design, complex AV\-over\-IP architecture or every manufacturer in the estate.

  

**Being You**

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.  



  

**What You Can Expect**

Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid\-friendly culture that supports your well\-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.
  

  

From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.
  

  

We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in\-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting\-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands\-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success.
  

  

We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next.


**Get Referred!**

If you know someone that works at Kyndryl, when asked ‘How Did You Hear About Us’ during the application process, select ‘Employee Referral’ and enter your contact's Kyndryl email address.

title: Network Engineer II - IN
description:
**Rackspace Cyber Defence**

**Security Engineer L2 (Network Security)**

**About Rackspace Cyber Defence**

Rackspace Cyber Defence is our next generation cyber defence and security operations capability that builds on 20\+ years of securing customer environments to deliver proactive, risk\-based, threat\-informed and intelligence driven security services.


**Our purpose** is to enable our customers to defend against the evolving threat landscape across on\-premises, private cloud, public cloud and multi\-cloud workloads.


**Our goal** is to go beyond traditional security controls to deliver cloud\-native, DevOps\-centric and fully integrated 24x7x365 cyber defence capabilities that deliver a **proactive** , **threat\-informed** , **risk\-based** , **intelligence\-driven** approach to detecting and responding to threats.


**Our mission** is to help our customers:


* Proactively detect and respond to cyber\-attacks – 24x7x365\.
* Defend against new and emerging risks that impact their business.
* Reduce their attack surface across private cloud, hybrid cloud, public cloud, and multi\-cloud environments.
* Reduce their exposure to risks that impact their identity and brand.
* Develop operational resilience.
* Maintain compliance with legal, regulatory and compliance obligations.

**What we’re looking for**

To support our continued success and deliver a Fanatical Experience™ to our customers, Rackspace Cyber Defence is looking for an Indian based Security Engineer, with a specialist in Network Security to support Rackspace’s strategic customers.


This role is particularly well\-suited to a self\-starting, experienced and motivated Sr. Security Engineer, who has a proven record of accomplishment in the design, delivery, management, operation and continuous improvement of enterprise\-level cloud security platforms or delivering managed security services to customers.


The primary focus will be on the design, implementation, management, operation and continuous improvement of cloud\-native security across customer Microsoft Azure, AWS and/or Google Cloud Platform (GCP) environment.


You will also be required to liaise closely with the customer’s key stakeholders, which may include incident response and disaster recovery teams as well as information security.


**Key Accountabilities**

* Ensure customer's network security and Azure environments remain secure, stable, and operational always.
* Assist with customer onboarding activities including:
	+ Platform onboarding
	+ Firewall policy implementation
	+ Azure network configuration
	+ Service transition and operations support
* Provide advanced operational support for Palo Alto and Fortinet firewall environments deployed in Azure and hybrid infrastructures.
* Investigate, troubleshoot, and resolve complex firewall, VPN, routing, and connectivity incidents.
* Own incidents through to resolution within L2 scope while ensuring clear communication with customers, stakeholders and within the Team.
* Perform detailed analysis of security and network events, identify incidents, and implement corrective actions.
* Manage and assist with firewall rule changes, policy optimizations, upgrades, migrations, and configuration updates.
* Troubleshoot App\-ID, URL Filtering, IPsec \& Remote VPN, Static \& Dynamic routing, NAT, connectivity issues and cloud network integration issues.
* Execute \& assist with maintenance and change activities while ensuring compliance with change management processes.
* Coordinate with vendors, cloud providers, and internal engineering teams for issue resolution.
* Escalate critical or complex issues to L3 teams with detailed technical analysis and recommendations.
* Participate in major incident management, post\-incident reviews, and root cause analysis activities.
* Contribute to operational documentation, knowledge articles, and process improvements.
* Mentor L1 engineers and provide technical guidance during incident resolution.
* Support after\-hours maintenance and critical incident activities when required.

**Skills \& Experience**

Mandatory Technical Skills


* 5\+ years of hands\-on Network Security experience.
* Proven expertise in:
	+ Palo Alto Networks, Panorama and VM\-Series Firewalls (Azure deployments)
	+ FortiManager and FortiGate VM Firewalls (Azure deployments)
	+ **Microsoft Azure Networking including:**
		- VNets
		- Subnets
		- Route Tables
		- NSGs
		- Azure Load Balancer
		- VPN Gateway
* **Strong knowledge of:**
	+ Firewall technologies
	+ IDS/IPS
	+ Network Detection and Response (NDR)
	+ Web Application Firewalls (WAF)
	+ Micro\-segmentation
	+ Hybrid and cloud\-native security architectures

* **Advanced operational experience including:**
	+ Packet level troubleshooting and analysis
	+ Firewall management and configuration using Panorama and FortiManager
	+ Firmware upgrades and lifecycle management
	+ Security rule optimization and compliance reviews
* Hands\-on experience supporting Azure\-hosted firewall solutions and cloud networking architecture.
* Strong understanding of Azure security services and cloud infrastructure security best practices.

**Desired Certifications**

* Palo Alto Networks Certified Network Security Engineer (PCNSE)
* Palo Alto Networks Certified Network Security Administrator (PCNSA)
* Fortinet NSE 4 / NSE 5 (or equivalent FCP certifications)
* Microsoft Azure Network Engineer Associate (AZ\-700\)
* Microsoft Azure Security Engineer Associate (AZ\-500\)

**Soft Skills**

* Self\-motivated, proactive, and customer\-focused professional.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem\-solving abilities.
* Excellent organizational and time\-management skills.
* Ability to prioritize multiple incidents in a fast\-paced operational environment.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills with technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Demonstrated commitment to customer satisfaction and continuous improvement.
* Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively across teams.
* Willingness to work flexible schedules and support critical customer situations.

  

**About Rackspace Technology**

We are the multicloud solutions experts. We combine our expertise with the world’s leading technologies — across applications, data and security — to deliver end\-to\-end solutions. We have a proven record of advising customers based on their business challenges, designing solutions that scale, building and managing those solutions, and optimizing returns into the future. Named a best place to work, year after year according to Fortune, Forbes and Glassdoor, we attract and develop world\-class talent. Join us on our mission to embrace technology, empower customers and deliver the future.

title: AV Resident / Onsite Professional
description:
**Job Description: AV Resident / Onsite Professional**

**Role Overview**

As an **Onsite AV Resident Professional**, you will be comprehensively responsible for organizing, troubleshooting, and managing advanced media equipment across the facility. This includes active/curved LED screens, Microsoft Teams Rooms (MTR) solutions, Yealink \& Panacast BYOD setups, and fully automated Training rooms, Boardrooms, and AV Experience Centers.

This role requires **in\-depth technical capabilities** to manage automated AV infrastructure, paired with **excellent technical communication skills** to interact with senior leadership teams during walkthroughs, demonstrations, and high\-profile events.

**Key Details**

· **Experience Required:** 4 to 8 years as an AV Technician and Audio Engineer

· **Education:** Diploma in Engineering or a similar technical field

· **Core Competencies:** AVC solutions, Microsoft MTR, IP Networking, Live Production, Stakeholder Management

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**

**Infrastructure Management \& Technical Support**

· **Setup \& Operations:** Install, configure, and operate video monitors, sound systems, microphones, lighting, mixing boards, and active LED screens.

· **Ground Support:** Provide "hands and feet" troubleshooting, ground\-level break\-fixing, and back\-end technical support for meetings and events.

· **Upgrades \& Maintenance:** Lead ground\-level execution for new installations, faulty equipment replacements, equipment additions/removals, and software/firmware upgrades.

· **Preventive Checks:** Perform daily room audits, connectivity checks, and preventative maintenance checklists to ensure the AV system is 100% bug and snag\-free.

· **Network \& Control:** Manage, tune, and operate integrated Audio/Video Control (AVC) solutions and IP networking setups.

**Event Management \& Executive Support**

· **Event Execution:** Plan, test, and run the AV technology for high\-quality events connecting remote global participants (e.g., Town Halls, All Hands Meetings, Executive Boardrooms, Global Training, Live Concerts, and Conventions).

· **Leadership Walkthroughs:** Coordinate end\-to\-end planning and dry\-runs for senior leadership and client walkthroughs.

· **Pre\-Event Preparation:** Capture event requirements directly from the Business team and execute comprehensive dry\-runs prior to the scheduled start.

· **Business Continuity:** Run ground\-level business continuity drills and ensure all rooms feature up\-to\-date user manuals and posters.**Stakeholder Coordination**

· **Cross\-Functional Collaboration:** Partner with the Program, Admin, and IT teams to swiftly implement functionality changes or address infrastructure bugs.

· **User Management:** Work directly with end\-user business teams to translate event concepts into professional audio, video, and live\-streaming production.

**Qualifications \& Technical Skills**

· **Technical Knowledge:** Deep familiarity with computer systems, IP networking, MTR setups, and AVC systems.

· **Troubleshooting:** Exceptional proactive diagnostics and timely resolution of complex equipment malfunctions.

· **Soft Skills:** Dynamic personality with strong managing capabilities, excellent interpersonal skills, and professional communication suited for executive leadership interaction.

Work Location: In person

title: Desktop & Network Support Engineer
description:
**Role Overview**  
We are looking for an **L1 IT / Network Support Engineer** to provide first\-level technical support for day\-to\-day IT infrastructure and network operations at the customer location.

The engineer will be responsible for monitoring, troubleshooting, and resolving basic IT, endpoint, network, and security\-related issues, while escalating complex incidents to the appropriate L2/L3 teams.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Provide **L1 technical support** for desktops, laptops, printers, network connectivity, and other IT infrastructure.
* Monitor network and security infrastructure and identify alerts or service disruptions.
* Troubleshoot basic **LAN/WAN, Wi\-Fi, Internet and connectivity\-related issues**.
* Perform basic troubleshooting of switches, routers, firewalls and access points.
* Support user onboarding/offboarding, system configuration and basic access\-related requests.
* Troubleshoot Windows OS, Microsoft 365, email, applications and endpoint\-related issues.
* Assist with installation, configuration and maintenance of IT hardware and software.
* Monitor endpoint/security alerts and escalate incidents as per defined procedures.
* Perform basic checks on antivirus/EDR and other security solutions.
* Log, update and track incidents and service requests through the designated **ticketing system**.
* Maintain proper documentation of incidents, troubleshooting steps and resolutions.
* Follow defined **SOPs, escalation matrix and SLA requirements**.
* Coordinate with L2/L3 support teams, OEMs and other service providers whenever required.
* Maintain an inventory of IT assets and support documentation.
* Provide regular updates on open incidents and pending issues to the reporting manager/customer SPOC.

**Required Technical Skills**

* Good understanding of **TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, LAN/WAN and Wi\-Fi**.
* Basic knowledge of **network switches, routers, firewalls and VPN**.
* Hands\-on experience with **Windows operating systems and Microsoft 365**.
* Basic understanding of endpoint security, antivirus/EDR and security best practices.
* Basic troubleshooting skills for hardware, software and network issues.
* Familiarity with IT ticketing/helpdesk systems.
* Good understanding of incident management and escalation processes.

**Desired Skills**

* Experience in an **enterprise IT support / NOC / helpdesk environment**.
* Exposure to network/security monitoring tools.
* Knowledge of any firewall platform such as **Sophos, SonicWall, Fortinet, Cisco, etc.**
* ITIL Foundation or relevant networking certification such as **CCNA** would be an advantage.

**Soft Skills**

* Strong troubleshooting and problem\-solving approach.
* Good verbal and written communication.
* Ability to interact professionally with end users and customer teams.
* Good documentation and reporting skills.
* Ability to work independently as well as with remote L2/L3 teams.
* Willingness to learn and work in a customer\-facing environment.

**Key Performance Areas**

* Timely response and resolution of L1 incidents.
* Adherence to agreed **SLA and escalation timelines**.
* Effective monitoring and identification of infrastructure issues.
* Accurate ticket updates and documentation.
* Reduction of recurring incidents through proper troubleshooting and escalation.

Pay: ₹30,000\.00 \- ₹40,000\.00 per month

Experience:

* network switches: 2 years (Preferred)
* firewalls : 2 years (Preferred)
* IT infrastructure: 2 years (Preferred)

License/Certification:

* CCNA certificate (Preferred)

title: Electronics Engineer
description:
Job Summary

We are looking for an experienced **Electronics \& Communication Engineer** with hands\-on experience in **shipbuilding/ship repair**, particularly in **EM Log systems, marine electronics, and engine automation systems**. The candidate will be responsible for installation, commissioning, testing, troubleshooting, and maintenance of electronic, communication, navigation, and automation systems onboard vessels.

Key Responsibilities

* Installation, testing, commissioning, and troubleshooting of **marine electronic and automation systems**.
* Hands\-on experience with **Electromagnetic Log (EM Log) systems**, including sensor installation, cabling, calibration, testing, and troubleshooting.
* Experience in **main engine and auxiliary engine automation systems**.
* Installation and commissioning of engine monitoring and control systems.
* Troubleshoot **PLC, control panels, sensors, transmitters, actuators, alarms, and indication systems**.
* Work with engine automation systems such as:
* Engine control and monitoring systems
* Alarm and monitoring systems
* Remote control systems
* Safety and shutdown systems
* RPM/speed monitoring
* Temperature and pressure monitoring
* Level and flow measurement systems
* Read and interpret **electrical/electronic drawings, wiring diagrams, schematics, and cable schedules**.
* Carry out cable termination, continuity checks, insulation testing, loop checking, and signal verification.
* Interface with **PLC, HMI, sensors, actuators, control panels, and communication networks**.
* Support installation and troubleshooting of marine communication and navigation equipment.
* Coordinate with **shipyard production, electrical, mechanical, commissioning, and QA/QC teams**.
* Coordinate with OEM/service engineers during installation, commissioning, and troubleshooting.
* Conduct harbour and sea trials and rectify system\-related observations.
* Prepare commissioning reports, test records, inspection reports, and system documentation.
* Ensure all work complies with **approved drawings, manufacturer recommendations, vessel specifications, class requirements, and applicable marine standards**.
* Follow shipyard safety procedures and ensure safe working practices onboard vessels.

Required Technical Knowledge

* Strong knowledge of **marine electronics and instrumentation**.
* Practical experience with **EM Log / Electromagnetic Speed Log**.
* Good understanding of **engine automation and control systems**.
* Knowledge of **PLC, HMI, I/O systems, sensors, transmitters, relays, control panels, and automation networks**.
* Familiarity with communication protocols such as **Modbus, CAN, RS\-485, Ethernet, and other marine communication interfaces**.
* Ability to troubleshoot electrical/electronic signals and control circuits.
* Knowledge of marine navigation and communication systems will be an added advantage.
* Ability to understand **P\&ID, wiring diagrams, single\-line diagrams, control schematics, and instrumentation drawings**.

Qualification

* **B.E./B.Tech in Electronics \& Communication Engineering (ECE)** or equivalent qualification.
* Candidates with a Diploma in Electronics/Electrical/Instrumentation Engineering with strong relevant shipbuilding experience may also be considered.
* **3–7 years of relevant experience**, preferably in shipbuilding, ship repair, marine automation, or vessel commissioning.

Preferred Experience

Candidates with practical experience in the following will be preferred:

* **EM Log installation and commissioning**
* Main Engine Automation
* Auxiliary Engine Automation
* Marine Alarm \& Monitoring Systems
* PLC\-based control systems
* Marine instrumentation
* Vessel commissioning and sea trials
* Navigation and communication systems
* Shipbuilding/ship repair projects

Key Skills

* Strong troubleshooting and problem\-solving skills
* Good technical communication
* Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings
* Ability to work independently onboard vessels
* Good coordination with OEMs, shipyard teams, and vessel crew
* Attention to detail and commitment to quality
* Willingness to work in **dock, shipyard, engine room, and onboard vessel environments**

Pay: ₹25,000\.00 \- ₹35,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Health insurance

Work Location: In person
